title: 30 Rock
overview: Multiple award-winning comedy 30 Rock is told through the comedic voice of Emmy and two-time Golden Globe winner Tina Fey as variety show producer Liz Lemon. The series also features two-time Emmy and three-time Golden Globe winner Alec Baldwin as top network executive Jack Donaghy and Emmy nominee Tracy Morgan as Tracy Jordan, the unpredictable star of Lemon's hit variety show, TGS with Tracy Jordan, Lemon constantly has her hands full, juggling corporate interference from Donaghy and off-the-handle star antics from Jordan, all while attempting to salvage her own personal life.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: Liz Lemon is called upstairs to meet the new network exec, Jack Donaghy, who instructs her to hire movie star Tracy Jordan to draw a young male audience to 'The Girlie Show'.

episodes.name: The Aftermath
episodes.overview: The crew of The Girlie Show is skeptical of having Tracy Jordan join the cast, especially when the show is retitled 'TGS Tracy Jordan'. Feeling everybody blames them, Liz and Tracy decide to throw a party on a yacht.

episodes.name: Blind Date
episodes.overview: Cupid has a new rival when Jack insists on sending Liz on a blind date with his out of town friend, Thomas.

episodes.name: Jack the Writer
episodes.overview: Lines are drawn when Jack decides to sit in on the writers' room and Kenneth the page tries to deal with Tracy's difficult demands.

episodes.name: Jack-Tor
episodes.overview: Jack is determined to act in a sketch on the show. Liz suspects Tracy may be illiterate.

episodes.name: Jack Meets Dennis
episodes.overview: Liz reconnects with her ex-boyfriend Dennis, the last remaining pager salesman in New York. Meanwhile, Jenna and Tracy try to "enhance" their appearances for career reasons.

episodes.name: Tracy Does Conan
episodes.overview: It's a star showdown when a dazed and confused Tracy bumps Jenna from her scheduled appearance on Late Night with Conan O'brien.

episodes.name: The Break-Up
episodes.overview: At the urging of everyone, Liz finally breaks up with her beeper salesman boyfriend, but the path back to "single and loving it" proves to be filled with unforeseen obstacles.

episodes.name: The Baby Show
episodes.overview: There are mommy issues on the set when Jenna tells everyone that Liz wants to get pregnant, and Jack gives her some very personal parental advice.

episodes.name: The Rural Juror
episodes.overview: Jenna can't wait for her new movie to open, but Liz won't tell her what she really thinks of her performance.

episodes.name: The Head and the Hair
episodes.overview: There are some new power players around when Jack and Kenneth the page switch roles for the day and Liz finds herself clicking with a gorgeous hunk.

episodes.name: Black Tie
episodes.overview: Liz, Jack and Jenna rub elbows with the upper crust at a prince's (Paul Reubens) birthday party. But the end of the evening finds Liz lying low after Jack's ex-wife (Isabella Rossellini) shows up.

episodes.name: Up All Night
episodes.overview: Valentine's Day is much more than candy and flowers when Jack celebrates the finalization of his divorce and the writers are forced to pull an all-nighter.

episodes.name: The "C" Word
episodes.overview: Being the boss isn't all it's cracked up to be when Liz overhears the writers discussing her management style and Jack tries to impress CEO Don Geiss (Rip Torn) at a charity golf tournament by bringing Tracy along.

episodes.name: Hard Ball
episodes.overview: It's negotiation time, and Jack plans to teach Liz a thing or two about how to handle Josh's new contract. Jenna makes several big publicity mistakes.

episodes.name: The Source Awards
episodes.overview: It's lights, camera, aggravation when Liz finds herself locked in a relationship with Tracy's determined new manager and Jack forces Tracy to host The Source Awards.

episodes.name: The Fighting Irish
episodes.overview: Family matters move front and centre when Jack is reunited with his down-and-out brother (Nathan Lane) and Liz has a tough time making staff cutbacks.

episodes.name: Fireworks
episodes.overview: Sparks are flying when Jack uses Kenneth the page to thwart an aggressive west coast NBC exec (Will Arnett) and Liz follows her crush to an AA meeting.

episodes.name: Corporate Crush
episodes.overview: Love is in the air, but Liz is concerned when Jack takes an overwhelming interest in her new boyfriend (Jason Sudeikis).

episodes.name: Cleveland
episodes.overview: There are certainly no sparks when Jack asks Liz to take his fiancee, Phoebe (Emily Mortimer), out for a ladies' lunch. But Liz finds a lot more to like when her boyfriend takes her to the great city of Cleveland.

episodes.name: Hiatus
episodes.overview: Tracy, on the run from the Black Crusaders, goes into hiding with Kenneth's cousin Jessie (Sean Hayes), and the pressure's on Liz to make the show work after Jack's mother (Elaine Stritch) arrives and Jack ends up in the hospital.

episodes.name: Seinfeld Vision
episodes.overview: As the cast and crew of TGS with Tracy Jordan returns for a new season, Liz is excited to see Jack again. However, her excitement quickly fades as Jack insists that Liz is still not over Floyd. Meanwhile, Jerry Seinfeld shows up at Jack's office in an upset mood after Jack announces his newest plan. Finally, Kenneth becomes Tracy's office wife when Tracy separates from his wife and Jenna returns to set a whole lot heavier now that she has been involved in Mystic Pizza: The Musical!.

episodes.name: Jack Gets in the Game
episodes.overview: When Jack discovers that his boss is retiring, he decides to get in the competition for his position. Meanwhile, Jenna begins to enjoy her fame for being fat and along with Jack encourages Liz to get her act together. Finally, Kenneth makes it his mission to get Tracy and Angie back together.

episodes.name: The Collection
episodes.overview: Jack hires his own private investigator to lead GE in the wrong direction so that they will not be able to find any dirt on him that might put him in a compromising position. However, when he is asked to give up his cookie jar collection, Jack finds the task too much of a challenge. Meanwhile, Angie announces that she will follow Tracy at all times to keep him in line, which Liz believes to be good until she covers for Tracy and gets on Angie's bad side. Finally, Jenna starts to worry once she starts to lose all the weight she gained over the summer and her popularity begins to hang on the line.

episodes.name: Rosemary's Baby
episodes.overview: When Liz meets her idol, Rosemary Howard, she invites her to be a guest writer on the show.

episodes.name: Greenzo
episodes.overview: It's time for Kenneth's annual house party, but he may be the only one excited about it. The soiree has only been attended by Liz in the past, so in order to get a better turnout Tracy spreads rumors that ultimately get out of hand. Meanwhile, Jack deals with NBC's new environmentally-friendly mascot, whose new-found stardom goes to his head.

episodes.name: Somebody to Love
episodes.overview: Jack falls for a congresswoman he meets at a cocktail party and despite the fact that they hold opposite views, the couple agrees to put politics aside and have a secret affair. Meanwhile, Liz believes her Middle Eastern neighbor to be a terrorist and tips off Homeland Security, creating a big mess.

episodes.name: Cougars
episodes.overview: As part of his community service, Tracy must coach a little league team. All goes well until Jack takes interest in the team and turmoil starts from there. Meanwhile, Liz is asked out on a date by Jamie, the new coffee boy, who thinks Liz is actually younger than she truly is.

episodes.name: Secrets and Lies
episodes.overview: C.C. wants to go public with her love for Jack, while Liz works at appeasing both Tracy and Jenna.

episodes.name: Ludachristmas
episodes.overview: The cast and writers of TGS prepare their annual Ludachristmas party in the writer's room.

episodes.name: Episode 210
episodes.overview: Jack and C.C. try to make their long distance romance work, Liz decides to invest in real estate, and Kenneth becomes addicted to caffeine.

episodes.name: MILF Island
episodes.overview: Just as "MILF Island" takes off, Jack suffers a setback when somebody runs a terrible quote in the New York Post calling him a "Grade-A Moron".

episodes.name: Subway Hero
episodes.overview: Dennis becomes a New York City celebrity after jumping in front of a train and saving someone who fell on the tracks. Meanwhile, Jack desperately tries to persuade Tracy to become the celebrity face of the Republican Party.

episodes.name: Succession
episodes.overview: Liz is shocked when Jack is promoted and names her his successor.

episodes.name: Sandwich Day
episodes.overview: Floyd stays at Liz's place overnight when his flight is canceled. Meanwhile, Jack is demoted to the 12th floor, causing him to question his future status at the company. Finally, the staff celebrates Annual Sandwich Day with mysterious sandwiches from a secret location in Brooklyn.

episodes.name: Cooter
episodes.overview: Jack hates his new job in Washington while back in New York, Liz deals with a pregnancy scare.

episodes.name: Do-Over
episodes.overview: Liz tries to keep the TGS staff from ruining her chances at adoption when an evaluator (Megan Mullally) drops by the job. Jack is back at 30 Rock to reclaim his position from Devin Banks (Will Arnett), but quickly learns the task won't be easy when he is given a sizeable demotion.

episodes.name: Believe in the Stars
episodes.overview: On a flight back from Chicago, Liz spills her soul to Oprah Winfrey. Meanwhile, Tracy and Jenna butt heads as they try to determine whose life is harder and Jack's morality is tested by Kenneth after an Olympics snafu.

episodes.name: The One with the Cast of 'Night Court'
episodes.overview: Liz and Jenna's free-spirited friend Claire (Jennifer Aniston) visits New York and falls hard for Jack. Kenneth, distressed over the new page uniforms, turns to Tracy who cheers him up with a surprise involving the cast of Night Court.

episodes.name: Gavin Volure
episodes.overview: Eccentric businessman Gavin Volure (Steve Martin) becomes enamored with Liz. Meanwhile, Tracy fears his kids may have sinister plans and Kenneth entrusts Jack to invest his savings in Gavin's business venture.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Liz is opposed to going to her high school reunion, but Jack manages to convince her otherwise. Meanwhile, Don Geiss (Rip Torn) wake up from his coma only to shock Jack with his declaration of who will be GE's CEO.

episodes.name: Christmas Special
episodes.overview: Liz participates in a charity program to help underprivileged kids celebrate Christmas. Meanwhile, Jack takes his frustration out on the TGS staff when his plans for a dream holiday vacation away from his overbearing mother are crushed.

episodes.name: Senor Macho Solo
episodes.overview: Jenna is concerned that Liz's attraction to a new guy (Peter Dinklage) has to do with her longing to have a child. Jack hits it off with his mother's nurse. Elisa (Salma Hayek) helps Tracy and Angie (Sherry Shepherd) arrange a post-nip, and tries to get Jenna an audition for the title role in a Janis Joplin biopic.

episodes.name: Flu Shot
episodes.overview: Liz fights for the staff's rights to flu shots from Dr. Spaceman (Chris Parnell). Meanwhile, Elisa is working seven days a week, so Jack must be creative about finding ways to spend time with her.

episodes.name: Retreat to Move Forward
episodes.overview: Nervous about the corporate retreat, Jack recruits Liz to accompany him for support. Jenna decides to take up method acting to prepare for her Janis Joplin role. Kenneth must convince Tracy that diabetes is affected by his diet.

episodes.name: Generalissimo
episodes.overview: Liz discovers she has a handsome and single neighbor (Jon Hamm) after receiving his mail by mistake. Due to Jack's striking resemblance to a spanish soap villain, Elisa's grandmother disapproves of their relationship. The new TGS interns invite Tracy out for a night of partying.

episodes.name: St. Valentine's Day
episodes.overview: Liz unintentionally insists her and Drew (Jon Hamm) have their first official date on Valentine's Day. Jack goes to church with girlfriend Elisa and Tracy helps Kenneth win the affection of a new staffer.

episodes.name: Larry King
episodes.overview: Jack considers taking the next step with Elisa while Tracy's interview on Larry King Live sends New York City into a panic. Liz recruits Kenneth to accompany her to chaotic Queens to retrieve her lost cell phone.

episodes.name: Goodbye, My Friend
episodes.overview: Liz befriends a pregnant teen in an attempt to adopt her baby. Jenna vies for more attention but Kenneth's plan to combine her birthday party with one for Tracy derails her efforts. Jack goes out with the guys and bonds with Frank over daddy issues.

episodes.name: The Funcooker
episodes.overview: When Liz can't scheme her way out of jury duty, chaos ensues on the set of TGS. With no one in charge, Tracy and Jenna begin to act irresponsibly, while Jack becomes absorbed in launching a lucrative new product.

episodes.name: The Bubble
episodes.overview: Liz spends more time with her boyfriend Drew (Jon Hamm) and finds that his handsomeness allows him to bypass many of the usual frustrations of daily life. Jack must find a way to convince Tracy to stay on at TGS after his contract expires and Jenna considers a new hairstyle to attract public attention.

episodes.name: Apollo, Apollo
episodes.overview: While Jack plans the perfect 50th birthday party for himself, he watches old home videos that inspire him to recreate one of the happiest moments he had a young boy. Liz's ex-boyfriend Dennis decides to come clean about an addiction, stirring up drama between Liz and Jenna.

episodes.name: Cutbacks
episodes.overview: Excitement for TGS's 50th show is quickly replaced by concern about company budget cuts. When Jack is forced to hand out pink slips, Liz does some personal bartering to save her staff.

episodes.name: Jackie Jormp-Jomp
episodes.overview: Suspended from work, Liz must learn to live without TGS. Meanwhile, when the film studio has second thoughts about releasing Jenna's Janis Joplin biopic, Jack needs Jenna to create some promotional buzz using her celebrity status.

episodes.name: The Ones
episodes.overview: When Jack and Elisa (Salma Hayek) think seriously about their engagement, he seeks advice from Tracy about the reality of married life. Elisa divulges to Liz she is keeping a secret. A prank results in an injury back at TGS and Jenna loses her cool over an attractive EMT.

episodes.name: The Natural Order
episodes.overview: Tracy and Liz stop receiving preferential treatment and experience what it means to be each other's equals. Jack's mother reveals unpleasant memories about Jack's father leaving the family. Jenna adopts a pet gibbon and learns the perils of motherhood.

episodes.name: Mama Mia
episodes.overview: Liz and Tracy convince Jack to begin the search for his real father (Alan Alda) and Tracy discovers an illegitimate son. Meanwhile, Jenna and Liz fight for the spotlight when Jenna gets recognition for one of Liz's ideas.

episodes.name: Kidney Now!
episodes.overview: The TGS staff rallies as Jack's father's (Alan Alda) health hangs in the balance. Liz enjoys newfound fame as a relationship expert. When Tracy's high school invites him to speak at graduation, Kenneth helps him overcome embarrassing memories.

episodes.name: Season 4
episodes.overview: Jack informs Liz that it's time for TGS to start appealing to middle America, and wants her to search for a new cast member.

episodes.name: Into the Crevasse
episodes.overview: Liz's book finally hits the stores, but she faces the wrath of Tracy when he finds out just how much he influenced what Liz wrote.

episodes.name: Stone Mountain
episodes.overview: Liz and Jack travel south to find their next great TGS talent.

episodes.name: Audition Day
episodes.overview: It's audition day at TGS and the cast and crew each have want their favorites chosen.

episodes.name: The Problem Solvers
episodes.overview: While the TGS crew await the arrival of their new cast member, Liz gets an offer of a lifetime.

episodes.name: Sun Tea
episodes.overview: It's green week and Kenneth does his part, with the help of Al Gore.

episodes.name: Dealbreakers Talk Show #0001
episodes.overview: Production begins on Liz's new talk show, Dealbreakers, and she realizes what it's like to walk in Jenna's shoes.

episodes.name: Secret Santa
episodes.overview: Jack takes a trip down memory lane when his high school crush resurfaces in his life.

episodes.name: Klaus and Greta
episodes.overview: Jenna enters in a fake relationship with James Franco while Jack tries to gain access to a drunken voicemail he left Nancy.

episodes.name: Black Light Attack!
episodes.overview: Danny reveals to Jack he's having secret make-out sessions with a TGS writer; Jenna auditions for Gossip Girl.

episodes.name: Winter Madness
episodes.overview: To boost morale at TGS, Liz and Jack take the gang up North for a work field trip.

episodes.name: Verna
episodes.overview: Jenna's estranged mother comes into town and Jenna turns to Jack for advice on how to deal with her.

episodes.name: Anna Howard Shaw Day
episodes.overview: Liz schedules her root canal on Valentine's Day, but has a hard time finding somebody to drive her home.

episodes.name: Future Husband
episodes.overview: Liz sets out to find the identity of a mystery number in her phone labeled "Future Husband."

episodes.name: Don Geiss, America and Hope
episodes.overview: Jack struggles to find his new place in the business after hearing of the Kabletown buy out and Liz continues to wonder if Wesley is the "one."

episodes.name: Floyd
episodes.overview: Revenge is in the air when Liz discovers an engaged Floyd is back in town to compete for a dream wedding on "The Today Show".

episodes.name: Lee Marvin vs. Derek Jeter
episodes.overview: Jack is torn between Nancy and Avery while Jenna offers to be Liz's wingman.

episodes.name: Khonani
episodes.overview: Determined to show her staff she knows how to cut loose, Liz offers to throw a bridal shower for Cerie.

episodes.name: Argus
episodes.overview: Liz steps in when Tracy and Dotcom argue over who will be Grizz's best man.

episodes.name: The Moms
episodes.overview: Liz sets out to reunite her mother with her one true love, Buzz Aldrin.

episodes.name: Emmanuel Goes to Dinosaur Land
episodes.overview: With Avery out of town, Nancy shows up to visit Jack. Liz revisits her old boyfriends and yet again runs into the unshakable Wesley. Tracy eschews a gritty, Oscar-caliber role to do a Garfield movie.

episodes.name: I Do Do
episodes.overview: Liz finally meets her soul mate, just as Jack is forced to finally decide between Avery and Nancy.

episodes.name: The Fabian Strategy
episodes.overview: Liz's boyfriend Carol comes to town, ready to take their relationship to the next level.

episodes.name: When It Rains, It Pours
episodes.overview: Liz turns on the charm to win over a TGS editor; Jack and Avery find out the gender of their baby.

episodes.name: Let's Stay Together
episodes.overview: Jack heads to Washington D.C. to speak on behalf of the NBC and Kabletown merger, and faces obstacles from a Rhode Island Congresswoman.

episodes.name: Live Show
episodes.overview: Liz is upset because nobody remembers her 40th birthday, Jack tries to give up drinking to support his pregnant girlfriend, and Tracy threatens to break character during TGS.

episodes.name: Reaganing
episodes.overview: Jack is on a winning streak and sets his sights on fixing Liz's relationship with Carol.

episodes.name: Gentleman's Intermission
episodes.overview: Avery makes Jack set up some boundaries when it comes to his friendship with Liz.

episodes.name: Brooklyn Without Limits
episodes.overview: Liz frequents a local boutique because she thinks she's helping the environment--and their jeans make her butt look good. Meanwhile, Jack helps an enemy's political rival, and Jenna helps Tracy aim for a Golden Globe nomination.

episodes.name: College
episodes.overview: Liz tries to buy her way to popularity after she wins the TGS crew's lottery.

episodes.name: Chain Reaction of Mental Anguish
episodes.overview: Liz begins to worry about her relationship and Jack advises her that it's time to seek a therapist.

episodes.name: Christmas Attack Zone
episodes.overview: Avery and Liz push Jack to unveil two giant secrets to his mother during her holiday visit.

episodes.name: Mrs. Donaghy
episodes.overview: Liz's New Year's resolutions cause trouble for Jack and Avery's wedding plans.

episodes.name: Operation Righteous Cowboy Lightning
episodes.overview: Jack hopes to make money for the network by pre-recording a disaster benefit that can go on-air.

episodes.name: ¡Qué Sorpresa!
episodes.overview: Jack does his best to impress the KableTown executives.

episodes.name: Double-Edged Sword
episodes.overview: Both Liz's and Jack's romantic getaways with their significant others turn into nightmares.

episodes.name: It's Never Too Late for Now
episodes.overview: The TGS gang tries to stop Liz's descent into spinsterhood while Frank and Pete start a band.

episodes.name: TGS Hates Women
episodes.overview: Liz hires a female writer in order to prove that TGS isn't sexist. Jack hatches a plot to manipulate his way to the top of KableTown.

episodes.name: Queen of Jordan
episodes.overview: Jack and Liz try to manipulate Angie into getting Tracy to return to TGS, while the "Queen of Jordan" cameras bring Jack some embarrassment.

episodes.name: Plan B
episodes.overview: With TGS on hiatus, the crew looks for other jobs. Meanwhile, Jack tries to salvage his cable network by enlisting the help of his arch nemesis.

episodes.name: I Heart Connecticut
episodes.overview: Liz and Ken go on a quest to find Tracy in New York, while Jenna and Jack work to get a horror film made by whatever means necessary.

episodes.name: 100: Part 1
episodes.overview: When Hank Hooper marks "TGS" for cancellation, Jack persuades him to let Liz and the crew try to change his mind by staging the show's 100th episode.

episodes.name: 100: Part 2
episodes.overview: When Hank Hooper marks "TGS" for cancellation, Jack persuades him to let Liz and the crew try to change his mind by staging the show's 100th episode.

episodes.name: Everything Sunny All the Time Always
episodes.overview: While Liz embraces spirituality, Jack has a heated duel with his ex-flame Condoleezza Rice!

episodes.name: Respawn
episodes.overview: Liz's attempt to get some R&R over vacation is spoiled by Tracy, a lonely Jack turns to Kenneth for company.

episodes.name: Dance Like Nobody's Watching
episodes.overview: Liz finds a new happiness; Jenna finds a popular new gig humiliating children on NBC's "America's Kidz Got Singing."

episodes.name: Idiots Are People Two!
episodes.overview: Liz strives to keep her boyfriend under wraps while a rant from Tracy unleashes a publicity nightmare.

episodes.name: Idiots Are People Three!
episodes.overview: Devon Banks returns to torment Jack while Tracy escalates his protest with Liz and Jenna call in a favor to solve a pesky Pete problem.

episodes.name: The Ballad of Kenneth Parcell
episodes.overview: Jenna, Liz, Jack and Tracy all get a new appreciation for the meaning of friendship.

episodes.name: Today You Are a Man
episodes.overview: Jack and Liz battle over her employment contract; Kenneth bolts from TGS for a new page assignment; Jenna and Tracy start moonlighting.

episodes.name: Hey, Baby, What's Wrong: Part 1
episodes.overview: On Valentine's Day, Liz and Criss brave a trip to Ikea; Avery's mother and Jack have a dalliance.

episodes.name: Hey, Baby, What's Wrong: Part 2
episodes.overview: On Valentine's Day, Liz and Criss brave a trip to Ikea; Avery's mother and Jack have a dalliance.

episodes.name: The Tuxedo Begins
episodes.overview: Liz discovers she must break social rules to achieve her goals; a mugging forces Jack to fight for rich people's rights.

episodes.name: Leap Day
episodes.overview: The spirit of Leap Day overtakes TGS, with lessons for everyone.

episodes.name: Alexis Goodlooking and the Case of the Missing Whisky
episodes.overview: Liz and Frank start "dating"; Jenna and Tracy tap into their inner cops; Jack molds Kenneth into a young corporate climber.

episodes.name: Standards and Practises
episodes.overview: Kenneth puts new restrictions on TGS programming, while Jack meets his nemesis.

episodes.name: St. Patrick's Day
episodes.overview: St. Patrick's Day isn't complete without ex-boyfriends, strategic board games and big green Hulk gloves.

episodes.name: Grandmentor
episodes.overview: Liz mentors Hazel in the ways of show business.

episodes.name: Kidnapped by Danger
episodes.overview: Diana, Avery's mother, arrives to oversee the film of her daughter's life.

episodes.name: The Shower Principle
episodes.overview: Liz's life and Jack's inspiration are stagnant.

episodes.name: Nothing Left to Lose
episodes.overview: A regained sense of smell conjures powerful emotions for Tracy.

episodes.name: Meet the Woggels
episodes.overview: Jack's mother ruins his couch factory opening, while Jenna crosses another sexual adventure off her list and Tracy solves a crisis with his son.

episodes.name: Murphy Brown Lied to Us
episodes.overview: Jack sets Liz up on a date while Jenna stages a public meltdown to win back Paul.

episodes.name: Live from Studio 6H
episodes.overview: When Jack tries to shut down live production of TGS, Kenneth teaches them all the lessons of live TV.

episodes.name: Queen of Jordan 2: The Mystery of the Phantom Pooper
episodes.overview: Angie's reality show returns, while Jack and Diana await Avery's arrival.

episodes.name: The Return of Avery Jessup
episodes.overview: Avery returns from North Korea with a stranger in tow; Liz and Criss struggle with their gender roles.

episodes.name: What Will Happen to the Gang Next Year?
episodes.overview: Jack and Avery renew vows, while Criss tries to prove to Liz that he's the one.

episodes.name: The Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: Liz discovers Jack's plan to ruin the network, while Hazel hatches an evil plan of her own and Jenna conscripts Liz into being her maid of honor.

episodes.name: Governor Dunston
episodes.overview: Liz must balance her new professional success with her love life, all while helping Jack bring down NBC.

episodes.name: Stride of Pride
episodes.overview: Jack takes his dating game up a notch, while Liz clashes with Tracy over an offensive tweet.

episodes.name: Unwindulax
episodes.overview: Jack and Liz go head to head as the political race heats up.

episodes.name: There's No I in America
episodes.overview: Realizing that Jenna could decide the Presidential election, Liz and Jack stage a debate to win her support and her followers.

episodes.name: Aunt Phatso vs. Jack Donaghy
episodes.overview: As Hazel schemes to become a TGS star, Jack and Tracy spar over Tracy's latest movie.

episodes.name: Mazel Tov, Dummies!
episodes.overview: Ready to adopt a baby, Liz and Criss try to plan a simple wedding... until things spin out of control.

episodes.name: My Whole Life Is Thunder
episodes.overview: As Jenna exacts revenge on Liz for her surprise wedding, Jack struggles once again to please his mother.

episodes.name: Game Over
episodes.overview: Jack spars with Kaylie Hooper over ultimate control of NBC.

episodes.name: Florida
episodes.overview: As Jack and Liz travel to Florida to wrap up his late mother's affairs, Jenna and Tracy take over TGS.

episodes.name: A Goon's Deed in a Weary World
episodes.overview: As Liz and Criss' new children arrive, Jack seeks a new head of NBC and TGS teeters on the edge.

episodes.name: Hogcock!
episodes.overview: Liz rallies the team to produce one final farewell production.

title: Black Mirror
overview: Over the last ten years, technology has transformed almost every aspect of our lives before we've had time to stop and question it. In every home; on every desk; in every palm - a plasma screen; a monitor; a smartphone--a black mirror of our 21st Century existence. Black Mirror is a contemporary British re-working of The Twilight Zone with stories that tap into the collective unease about our modern world.

episodes.name: The National Anthem
episodes.overview: Prime Minister Michael Callow faces a huge and shocking dilemma when Princess Susannah, a much-loved member of the Royal Family, is kidnapped.

episodes.name: Fifteen Million Merits
episodes.overview: In the near future, everyone is confined to a life of strange physical drudgery. The only way to escape is to enter the 'Hot Shot' talent show and pray you can impress the judges.

episodes.name: The Entire History of You
episodes.overview: A jealous husband, Liam Foxwell, suspects that his wife was involved with another man. Thanks to an implant that lets anyone play memories back as long and as often as they want, he sets out to confirm his suspicions.

episodes.name: Be Right Back
episodes.overview: When a man named Ash dies, his girlfriend Martha is grief-stricken... until a friend directs her to a service that can create an AI programmed with Ash's online personality. Eventually the software offers Martha a new improvement: a physical body for it to occupy.

episodes.name: White Bear
episodes.overview: A woman, Victoria, wakes up with amnesia and a fellow survivor tells her that nine-tenths of the world's population have been turned into photo-taking zombies by a mysterious TV signal. To get to safety, they have to evade the sadistic hunters and destroy the White Bear transmitter. However, Victoria soon realizes that something far more sinister is going on.

episodes.name: The Waldo Moment
episodes.overview: An animated blue bear, Waldo, proves surprisingly successful as a third-party candidate. But Jamie Salter, the voice of Waldo, begins to have second thoughts when he learns what the governments of the world intend to use Waldo for.

episodes.name: Nosedive
episodes.overview: A woman desperate to boost her social media score hits the jackpot when she's invited to a swanky wedding. But the trip doesn't go as planned.

episodes.name: Playtest
episodes.overview: An American traveler short on cash signs up to test a revolutionary new gaming system, only to discover the thrills are a little too real.

episodes.name: Shut Up and Dance
episodes.overview: After a virus infects his laptop, a teen faces a daunting choice: carry out orders delivered by text message, or risk having intimate secrets exposed.

episodes.name: San Junipero
episodes.overview: In a seaside town in 1987, a shy young woman and an outgoing party girl strike up a powerful bond that seems to defy the laws of space and time.

episodes.name: Men Against Fire
episodes.overview: After his first battle with an elusive enemy, a soldier begins experiencing unfamiliar sensations and strange technical glitches.

episodes.name: Hated in the Nation
episodes.overview: The death of a journalist at the center of a social media firestorm leads a veteran detective and her tech-savvy apprentice to a chilling discovery.

episodes.name: USS Callister
episodes.overview: Capt. Robert Daly presides over his crew with wisdom and courage. But a new recruit will soon discover nothing on this spaceship is what it seems.

episodes.name: Arkangel
episodes.overview: Worried about her daughter's safety, single mom Marie signs up for a cutting-edge device that monitors the girl's whereabouts -- and much more.

episodes.name: Crocodile
episodes.overview: Architect Mia scrambles to keep a dark secret under wraps, while insurance investigator Shazia harvests people's memories of a nearby accident scene.

episodes.name: Hang the DJ
episodes.overview: Paired up by a dating program that puts an expiration date on all relationships, Frank and Amy soon begin to question the system's logic.

episodes.name: Metalhead
episodes.overview: At an abandoned warehouse, scavengers searching for supplies encounter a ruthless foe and flee for their lives through a bleak wasteland.

episodes.name: Black Museum
episodes.overview: On a dusty stretch of highway, a traveler stumbles across a museum that boasts rare criminal artifacts -- and a disturbing main attraction.

episodes.name: Striking Vipers
episodes.overview: When old college friends Danny and Karl reconnect in a VR version of their favorite video game, the late-night sessions yield an unexpected discovery.

episodes.name: Smithereens
episodes.overview: A London rideshare driver ignites an international crisis when he kidnaps a worker from a social media company.

episodes.name: Rachel, Jack and Ashley, Too
episodes.overview: A lonely teen becomes obsessed with a robot doll based on her pop star idol, Ashley O -- just as the real Ashley's life begins to unravel.

episodes.name: Joan Is Awful
episodes.overview: An average woman is stunned to discover a global streaming platform has launched a prestige TV drama adaptation of her life — in which she is portrayed by Hollywood A-lister Salma Hayek.

episodes.name: Loch Henry
episodes.overview: A young couple travel to a sleepy Scottish town to start work on a genteel nature documentary – but find themselves drawn to a juicy local story involving shocking events of the past.

episodes.name: Beyond the Sea
episodes.overview: In an alternative 1969, two men on a perilous high-tech mission wrestle with the consequences of an unimaginable tragedy.

episodes.name: Mazey Day
episodes.overview: A troubled starlet is dogged by invasive paparazzi while dealing with the consequences of a hit-and-run incident.

episodes.name: Demon 79
episodes.overview: Northern England, 1979. A meek sales assistant is told she must commit terrible acts to prevent disaster.

episodes.name: Common People
episodes.overview: When a medical emergency leaves schoolteacher Amanda fighting for her life, her desperate husband Mike signs her up for Rivermind, a high-tech system that will keep her alive.

episodes.name: Eulogy
episodes.overview: An isolated man is introduced to a groundbreaking system that allows its users to literally step inside old photographs — stirring powerful emotions in the process.

title: Seinfeld
overview: Seinfeld is the story of a fictionalized version of stand-up comedian Jerry Seinfeld, his life in New York City and his quirky group of friends who join him in wrestling with life's most perplexing, yet often trivial questions. Often described as "a show about nothing," Seinfeld mines the humor in life's mundane situations like waiting in line, searching for a lost item, or the trials and tribulations of dating.

episodes.name: Good News, Bad News
episodes.overview: Jerry is excited that a woman he met on the road is coming to visit him in New York. However, he has a tough time discerning whether her intentions are romantic or platonic.

episodes.name: The Stakeout
episodes.overview: When Jerry goes to a birthday party with Elaine, he meets a woman he'd like to ask out, but doesn't get the chance to. When she leaves before he gets a chance to find out her name, he and George stakeout her office building.

episodes.name: The Robbery
episodes.overview: When Jerry's apartment gets robbed, he decides to move out. George shows him a great apartment, which he plans to take… that is, until George expresses his own desire for the apartment.

episodes.name: Male Unbonding
episodes.overview: Jerry ponders a few courses of action when he sees that he no longer has anything in common with a clingy and obnoxious childhood friend. George has trouble with his latest relationship. Kramer has the idea to open a chain of pizza parlors where you make your own pizza pie.

episodes.name: The Stock Tip
episodes.overview: Jerry and George invest based on an insider stock tip, but then lose touch with their inside source. A nervous Jerry lets the declining stock ruin his weekend away with Vanessa, while George decides he's all in.

episodes.name: The Ex-Girlfriend
episodes.overview: Jerry begins to date George's ex - girlfriend before he discovers how clingy she is. Meanwhile George refuses to pay a physical therapist, convinced he did nothing and Elaine has a run - in with a friend who has stopped saying "hello" to her.

episodes.name: The Pony Remark
episodes.overview: Jerry worries that he may have killed an old relative, after he offends her with an off-the-cuff comment about hating kids who had ponies growing up.

episodes.name: The Phone Message
episodes.overview: George regrets not going upstairs for "coffee" after a date, and proceeds to leave his girlfriend a series of increasingly embarrassing phone messages. Meanwhile, Jerry and his girlfriend argue over the comedic value of a TV commercial.

episodes.name: The Apartment
episodes.overview: Jerry helps Elaine get the apartment above his, but later regrets doing so. George's experiment of wearing a wedding band to attract women goes horribly awry.

episodes.name: The Revenge
episodes.overview: George quits his job in a huff, but comes to regret the decision, and is later humiliated by his boss. Jerry believes that the man at the laundromat has stolen a large sum of money from his laundry bag. Employing Elaine's and Kramer's help, respectively, they each plan revenge.

episodes.name: The Chinese Restaurant
episodes.overview: Jerry, Elaine, and George endure a series of misadventures while waiting the entire episode to get a table at a Chinese restaurant.

episodes.name: The Truth
episodes.overview: Jerry's audit becomes more trouble than he can handle when George breaks up with the former IRS worker who was helping Jerry, and she ends up in a sanitorium. Meanwhile, Kramer and Elaine have trouble getting along while Kramer dates Elaine's roommate.

episodes.name: The Pen
episodes.overview: Jerry and Elaine travel to Florida to see Jerry's parents which they soon regret when Elaine injures her back on a fold - out couch and Jerry gets caught up in a scandal by just saying that he liked someone's pen.

episodes.name: The Library
episodes.overview: Jerry is investigated by the library for a book he checked out in 1971 and never returned. Elaine fears for her career when her boss hates her recommendations, and Kramer strikes up a relationship with the librarian. Meanwhile, George believes that a homeless man is his old gym teacher, whom he got fired.

episodes.name: The Cafe
episodes.overview: Jerry tries helping the owner of a small restaurant attract customers by giving him a suggestion. George must take an IQ test for his latest girlfriend, so Elaine helps him in "a caper" where she takes the test for him. Kramer tries to keep his mother's ex-boyfriend's jacket, because it helps him meet women; however the ex-boyfriend comes looking for it.

episodes.name: The Tape
episodes.overview: While listening to a tape of his previous nights show, Jerry hears the voice of a mysterious woman who talks dirty into his tape recorder and everyone becomes excited by the voice. George tries a new cure for baldness. Kramer searches for the jacket.

episodes.name: The Nose Job
episodes.overview: Jerry's brain and penis play chess against one another to decide whether he should keep dating a vacuous model with whom the "sex is great" but not anything else. George is dating a woman with a big nose, Kramer tells her it like it is and she gets a nose job; however, there is a complication. Kramer gets Elaine to help him retrieve the jacket.

episodes.name: The Alternate Side
episodes.overview: Jerry's car is stolen and the criminal picks up his car phone. George decides to take a fill-in job moving cars from one side of the street to the other; this turns into a disaster for local traffic flow. Kramer gets a chance to do a line in a Woody Allen film; "these pretzels are making me thirsty." Elaine gets tired of her 66-year-old boyfriend and when she is about to break up with him, he has a stroke.

episodes.name: The Subway
episodes.overview: Everyone has an uncommon experience while going their separate ways on the subway. George meets a beautiful woman who distracts him from his intended destination, a job interview. Jerry falls asleep and then wakes up across from a fat naked man. Elaine's train stops in the middle of a tunnel on her way to be best man at a lesbian wedding. Kramer overhears a hot tip on a horse on his way to pay $600 in traffic violations.

episodes.name: The Suicide
episodes.overview: Elaine needs to fast before an x-ray, so she tries stuffing herself three days before the test. After his neighbor Martin tries suicide, Jerry is hit on by his girlfriend, Gina, while at the hospital. A psychic warns George to cancel his vacation to the Cayman Islands, but never can tell George why. Jerry becomes worried when Newman (a friend of Martins) sees him with Gina. Elaine starts hallucinating from hunger. Everything hinges on a Drake's coffee cake.

episodes.name: The Boyfriend (1)
episodes.overview: Jerry becomes increasingly jealous of Elaine's relationship with Keith Hernandez. The unemployed George Constanza schemes to collect unemployment checks, while the illustrated JFK "second spitter theory" is further investigated.

episodes.name: The Limo
episodes.overview: Jerry and George lie their way into a limo heading for Madison Square Garden to, or so they think, a Knicks/Bulls basketball game. Along the way they pick up Elaine and Kramer but soon become fearful of two Neo-Nazis and discover the event they're really headed to.

episodes.name: The Letter
episodes.overview: Jerry learns that his new artist friend, from whom George has been forced to buy a painting, plagiarized a letter to keep him from breaking up with her. Elaine refuses to remove her Baltimore Orioles cap during a New York Yankees game.

episodes.name: The Keys
episodes.overview: Jerry is fed up with Kramer coming into his apartment any time he feels like it and asks him to return his spare set of keys. Kramer begrudgingly complies but then lets it be known that he's leaving for California. When Jerry forgets his keys, he gets George to let him into Elaine's apartment so her can get his spare set.

episodes.name: The Trip (1)
episodes.overview: When Jerry is asked to appear on The Tonight Show in Los Angeles, George accompanies him to look for Kramer.

episodes.name: The Pitch
episodes.overview: NBC executives ask Jerry to come up with an idea for a TV series. George decides he can be a sitcom writer and comes up with "nothing." Kramer trades a radar detector for a helmet, and later Newman receives a speeding ticket.

episodes.name: The Bubble Boy
episodes.overview: Jerry agrees to visit a boy who lives in a plastic bubble on the way to Susan's parents' cabin. Jerry and Elaine, however, get lost; George and Susan visit the bubble boy instead, which later results in a fight after a misprint in Trivial Pursuit.

episodes.name: The Opera
episodes.overview: Elaine unknowingly is dating Crazy Joe Davola, who has just left a threatening message on Jerry's recorder.

episodes.name: The Contest
episodes.overview: After George is caught masturbating by his mother, the four main characters devise a contest to see who can go the longest without pleasuring him/herself. Marla, Jerry's girlfriend, with whom he has yet to have sex, learns of the contest and is disgusted.

episodes.name: The Pick
episodes.overview: George lobbies to get Susan back, only to regret the success of his efforts. Tia (the model Jerry met in "The Airport") dumps Jerry after she sees what appears to be Jerry picking his nose while driving. Elaine decides to send out Christmas cards with her picture on them, and accidentally chooses a revealing shot.

episodes.name: The Movie
episodes.overview: Jerry does a set at a comedy club, then goes to meet George, Elaine, and Kramer afterward to see a screening of Checkmate. However, a simple miscommunication causes the four to keep missing each other at two different theaters.

episodes.name: The Visa
episodes.overview: George meets an attractive lawyer, Cheryl, who is impressed by his sense of humor. George attempts to keep Elaine and Jerry from meeting Cheryl, believing that Jerry's sense of humor will eclipse him. Babu Bhatt, the former restaurant owner who Jerry helped drive out of business in "The Cafe" (Season 3), has trouble with the INS because Babu's visa renewal was accidentally delivered to Jerry.

episodes.name: The Outing
episodes.overview: A prank by Elaine leads a newspaper journalist to think that Jerry and George are gay.

episodes.name: The Old Man
episodes.overview: Elaine gets the gang to volunteer at an old folks' home. She gets freaked out by hers, George gets fired by his guy, and Jerry loses his. Kramer and Newman scheme to sell records to a vintage music store and steal the records from Jerry's old guy.

episodes.name: The Implant
episodes.overview: Jerry insists that his new girlfriend has implants. But she keeps insisting that they're "real and spectacular". The mystery goes even deeper when Elaine meets her in the sauna and trips and lands on her breasts.

episodes.name: The Smelly Car
episodes.overview: Jerry and Elaine realize that the valet who parked Jerry's car has really bad B.O. Jerry soon realizes that the smell isn't just a mere odor, but an entity unto itself, and finally decides that he has to get rid of his car. Meanwhile, George gets reacquainted with Susan and discovers that he drove her to lesbianism, and Kramer dates Susan's girlfriend.

episodes.name: The Pilot (1)
episodes.overview: "Jerry"'s pilot finally airs. Elaine avoids the romantic pursue of Dalrymple.

episodes.name: The Mango
episodes.overview: Elaine makes a startling confession.

episodes.name: The Glasses
episodes.overview: George loses his glasses at the health club.

episodes.name: The Bris
episodes.overview: Jerry and Elaine are asked to be godparents.

episodes.name: The Non-Fat Yogurt
episodes.overview: Kramer invests in a new non-fat yogurt store.

episodes.name: The Barber
episodes.overview: Jerry regrets giving his longtime barber the heave-ho after he gets a ridiculous-looking haircut. George gets a job interview but the boss leaves him with a very cryptic ending. Kramer begs Elaine to let him take part in her charity bachelor auction.

episodes.name: The Masseuse
episodes.overview: Jerry gets mad when he dates a masseuse. Kramer and George get massages while Jerry doesn't. Meanwhile, Elaine's new boyfriend is Joel Rifkin, an innocent man who shares the same name as one of New York's most notorious serial killers.

episodes.name: The Conversion
episodes.overview: George decides to convert to Latvian Orthodox to impress a girl, against his angry parents' objections. Meanwhile, Kramer converts a nun at the church, and Jerry takes a peek in his girlfriend's medicine cabinet and is stunned by what he finds.

episodes.name: The Dinner Party
episodes.overview: En route to a dinner party, Jerry and Elaine stop off at a bakery and get held up when the bakery runs out of what they want to purchase. Meanwhile, George and Kramer, en route to said dinner party, stop off at a liquor store to buy a bottle of wine and have a hard time picking one out.

episodes.name: The Pie
episodes.overview: While shopping for a new suit for a job interview, George and the others stumble upon a mannequin which scarily resembles Elaine. Meanwhile Jerry tries to figure out why his girlfriend won't try his apple pie at Monks.

episodes.name: The Wife
episodes.overview: While Jerry keeps up the pretense of a pretend marriage with new girlfriend, Meryl, so she can share his dry cleaning discount, Elaine tries to decipher whether a guy at the gym likes her and simultaneously tries to keep him from reporting George to the manager for peeing in the shower; and Kramer prepares to meet his girlfriend, Anna's parents.

episodes.name: The Raincoats (2)
episodes.overview: In this two-part episode, Jerry's parents are visiting before leaving for France which prevents Jerry from having alone time with his new girlfriend, Rachel. George uses the trip to get out of volunteering for the Big Brother program. Kramer and Morty team up to sell Morty's old belt-less trench coat "The Executive" to a vintage clothing store. Elaine's creepy new boyfriend is a "close talker" who enjoys spending time with Jerry's parents.

episodes.name: The Fire
episodes.overview: Kramer pitches his idea for a coffee table book about coffee tables. Kramer takes Toby to see Jerry's act but she heckle's him from the audience. George overreacts somewhat to a fire in the kitchen, showing a side of his character that his new girlfriend does not like.

episodes.name: The Chaperone
episodes.overview: Jerry dates a Miss America contestant.

episodes.name: The Pledge Drive
episodes.overview: Kramer finds Jerry's old birthday checks from his grandmother and insists he deposits them, which puts Nana in unexpected debt. Elaine accidentally tells the high talker a secret. Mr Pitt eats a Snickers bar with utensils.

episodes.name: The Couch
episodes.overview: Elaine dates a moving guy, and things are going well for her until Jerry wants to know what his opinion on abortion is. Poppy returns and he and Kramer are going into business together to create a restaurant where you make your own pizza. Meanwhile, George goes out of his way to cheat on a book club test by renting "Breakfast At Tiffany's" instead of reading the book.

episodes.name: The Soup
episodes.overview: Kramer convinces Jerry to get a free Armani suit from hack comic Kenny Bania. But when Bania decides that he doesn't want anything except for dinner, Jerry has a hard time accepting the suit knowing that there is a far greater catch involved. Things get even worse when, during the dinner, Bania insists that soup doesn't count as a meal. Meanwhile, Elaine has a British friend stay with her for a week.

episodes.name: The Secretary
episodes.overview: George gets a secretary, saying he will go for efficiency and smarts rather than beauty. He hires a librarian-esque woman, only to find himself falling in love with her.

episodes.name: The Race
episodes.overview: Jerry dates a girl named Lois, though her boss is Duncan Meyer, an old high school rival of Jerry's, who Jerry once defeated in a track meet, though Duncan has protested the race ever since, and now wants a rematch. Elaine finds out her boyfriend is a communist, George contacts a personal ad from "The Daily Worker", and Kramer gets a job as a shopping center Santa.

episodes.name: The Switch
episodes.overview: Elaine loans Mr. Pitt's expensive tennis racket to an executive from Doubleday who hints there may be a job opening for Elaine soon. Jerry's girlfriend never smiles or laughs at his jokes but her roommate laughs at everything he says so he contemplates the switch. George's girlfriend, a model, eats a lot but never puts on weight.

episodes.name: The Scofflaw
episodes.overview: When George learns that their friend Gary never had cancer as he claimed, he promises to keep it a secret from Jerry. Elaine gets all tied up in knots when she learns that someone said hi to her ex-boyfriend on her behalf. Kramer has a run-in with the local beat cop who tells him there's someone in the neighborhood who has amassed parking tickets for years.

episodes.name: The Kiss Hello
episodes.overview: Kramer tries to create a Utopian society when he puts up pictures of all the residents of his and Jerry's building. Jerry doesn't mind until the women of the building want to be greeted with a kiss. After Jerry objects to kissing hello, he's vilified and nearly kicked out of the building. Meanwhile, Elaine's friend who is a chiropractor skips out on George's appointment and goes skiing instead, and they have a hard time telling her about her dated hairdo.

episodes.name: The Jimmy
episodes.overview: The gang has various encounters with a man named Jimmy, who talks about himself in the 3rd person. Jerry suspects Tim Whatley and his assistant are using patients for sexual pleasures. George cuts a deal with Jimmy to sell Jimmy's shoes, but Jimmy gets injured thanks to Kramer's drooling.

episodes.name: The Fusilli Jerry
episodes.overview: Kramer gets new license plates, but a DMV screw-up gives him a new vanity license plate. George's mom gets plastic surgery. Jerry tells Puddy about his "move", which he proceeds to use on Elaine.

episodes.name: The Face Painter
episodes.overview: Jerry scores premium tickets to a New Jersey Devils playoff game. But Jerry gets weirded out when Puddy shows up at the game and paints his face to match the team colors. Kramer enjoys the game so much that he tries to convince Jerry to get more tickets from the guy Jerry got them from. Meanwhile, George decides to tell his girlfriend that he loves her, only to have the plans backfire on him while Kramer battles a chimpanzee at the zoo.

episodes.name: The Engagement
episodes.overview: Elaine has a problem sleeping in her new apartment because of a dog that keeps barking. Meanwhile, George gets back together with Susan Ross, proposes to her, then begins to have seconds thoughts about it. Jerry breaks up with Melanie because of her peculiar eating habits and Kramer's solution to help Elaine includes Newman, a van and a case of dog-napping.

episodes.name: The Maestro
episodes.overview: Elaine dates the conductor of an orchestra who insists everyone calls him "Maestro."

episodes.name: The Hot Tub
episodes.overview: George picks up a bad habit from some visiting baseball officials. During the time of the New York City Marathon, Elaine has an out of country runner as her house guest. The runner had overslept and missed the big race at the last Olympics and Jerry obsesses with ensuring that it doesn't happen again. Kramer gets a hot tub from his friend Lomez, and Elaine has writer's block.

episodes.name: The Soup Nazi
episodes.overview: A soup stand owner obsesses about his customers' ordering procedure, but his soup is so good that people line up down the block for it anyway.

episodes.name: The Secret Code
episodes.overview: George refuses to give anyone his secret code (BOSCO). Kramer buys a police scanner. Jerry does a series of ads for Leapin' Larry's Appliance Store. Elaine has dinner with J. Peterman but after she and Jerry bail on the dinner, George is stuck to dine with Peterman. George spills his secret code to Peterman's dying mother and gets in trouble for it.

episodes.name: The Sponge
episodes.overview: After learning that her prophylactic of choice is being discontinued, Elaine buys a case of Today sponges and scrutinizes her dates for their sponge-worthiness.

episodes.name: The Rye
episodes.overview: After George's parents take back the bread they gifted to Susan's parents, George makes Jerry find another loaf and tries to appease Susan's parents by taking them on Kramer's Manhattan horse tours, to disastrous consequences.

episodes.name: The Seven
episodes.overview: George meets Susan's cousins. The wife is expecting a baby and they are having a hard time agreeing on the name. George reveals that he wants to name his kid Seven after Mickey Mantle. The cousins like the idea of naming their kid Seven, but nobody else does. Elaine buys an antique bicycle and hurts her neck in the process. Kramer fixes her neck and wants the bicycle in exchange for payment. Jerry's new girlfriend wears the same dress every single day.

episodes.name: The Shower Head
episodes.overview: Peterman wants Elaine to go to Africa, but when Elaine tests positive for Opium in her physical, that means no dice. George tries to convince his parents to move to Florida so that he finally gets his "buffer zone", but they have problems with Jerry's parents. Kramer and Newman scheme to buy black market shower heads when the building switches to low-flow ones.

episodes.name: The Friars Club
episodes.overview: Jerry has a hard time getting membership in the Friar's Club when the Flying Santos Brothers take his jacket during a show. Meanwhile, Elaine suspects that a new co-worker (Rob Schnieder) is faking a hearing disorder to get out of doing work.

episodes.name: The Calzone
episodes.overview: George gets Steinbrenner hooked on eggplant calzones from a local Italian restaurant. But George gets banned from the restaurant when he's accused of stealing from the tip jar. He then asks Kramer to pick up the calzones, but Kramer gets kicked out when he tries to pay with pennies. George's last resort in getting the calzones is Newman who wants a cut of every delivery. Meanwhile, Kramer will only wear clothing if it's straight from the dryer.

episodes.name: The Wait Out
episodes.overview: A comment from George ends up causing a married couple to get divorced and Jerry and Elaine to date the soon-to-be exes. Kramer tries wearing jeans.

episodes.name: The Foundation
episodes.overview: George enjoys the single life. Elaine takes over the catalog when J. Peterman suddenly goes missing. Kramer is taking karate lessons.

episodes.name: The Bizarro Jerry
episodes.overview: George uses Susan's death to pick up women. Elaine's new friend is Jerry's exact opposite. Jerry's new girlfriend has manly hands. Kramer pretends to work for an upscale firm.

episodes.name: The Package
episodes.overview: A mysterious package arrives for Jerry. Elaine is curious about what the doctors are writing in her records. George tries to hit on the cute girl at the "One Hour Photo" place.

episodes.name: The Fatigues
episodes.overview: Jerry's new girlfriend's mentor is dating Bania. Kramer volunteers to host a Jewish singles mixer. George tries to study up on risk management. Elaine promotes a man she is afraid to fire.

episodes.name: The Checks
episodes.overview: Jerry gets hundreds of royalty checks, worth 12 cents each, for appearing on a Japanese TV program and gets writer's cramp. George and Jerry pitch their pilot to Japanese TV executives.

episodes.name: The Abstinence
episodes.overview: Abstinence allows George to become a genius, but it turns Elaine into an idiot. Jerry gets bumped from career day at his old Jr. High School. Kramer turns his apartment into a smoking lounge and all the smoke disfigures his face.

episodes.name: The Little Jerry
episodes.overview: Jerry bounces a check. Kramer buys a live chicken. George dates a female convict. Elaine dates a man who shaves his head.

episodes.name: The Money
episodes.overview: Jerry's parents believe he is financially unstable. Kramer has trouble sleeping with his girlfriend. Elaine enjoys her position as President of the J. Peterman catalog. George hopes to get his parents' money when they die.

episodes.name: The Comeback
episodes.overview: George tries to come up with a good comeback after someone insults him. Elaine falls in love with a mysterious employee at the video store. Kramer wants to die a certain way. Jerry takes advice from a tennis player who stinks.

episodes.name: The Susie
episodes.overview: Kramer sets his watch an hour ahead. George tries to avoid a breakup with his girlfriend. A colleague keeps calling Elaine, Susie. Jerry gambles on a basketball game, but the bookie can't pay him.

episodes.name: The English Patient
episodes.overview: Elaine is dragged to see the movie "The English Patient" on multiple occasions, even though she absolutely hates the film.

episodes.name: The Yada Yada
episodes.overview: George's new girlfriend keeps including "Yada Yada" in her stories. Jerry is offended by Tim Whatley's Jewish jokes. Elaine tries to help her friends adopt a baby. Kramer and Mickey fight over two women.

episodes.name: The Muffin Tops
episodes.overview: Elaine opens a new bakery that sells only the tops of the muffins.

episodes.name: The Summer of George
episodes.overview: Unemployed again, George decides to have a "memorable" summer. Jerry's new girlfriend has another dude. Kramer wins a Tony Award. A new girl at work is hostile towards Elaine.

episodes.name: The Butter Shave
episodes.overview: Kramer discovers the amazing yet unknown uses of butter, but accidentally fries himself after using it as sunscreen.

episodes.name: The Serenity Now
episodes.overview: Jerry opens up his feelings. Elaine is getting hit on by the Jews. Kramer gets a screen door. George helps his father sell computers.

episodes.name: The Junk Mail
episodes.overview: Kramer is annoyed with the catalogs he keeps getting in the mail. Elaine falls in love with a guy because of his smile. George's parents are avoiding him. Jerry can't find it in his heart to reject a gift from an old school friend.

episodes.name: The Slicer
episodes.overview: Elaine borrows Kramer's meat slicer to feed her neighbor's cat while George tries to hide his not-so-great past from his new boss.

episodes.name: The Apology
episodes.overview: Jerry dates a nudist, and George seeks an apology from an old friend.

episodes.name: The Strike
episodes.overview: Jerry goes out with a woman who is beautiful one day and ugly the next. Kramer goes back to work at H&H Bagels. George makes up a charity. Elaine gives a fake number to a man.

episodes.name: The Dealership
episodes.overview: Jerry looks to buy a new car from Elaine's boyfriend. George tries to find a snack. Kramer test drives a car.

episodes.name: The Cartoon
episodes.overview: Sally Weaver makes fun of Jerry. George's new girlfriend looks just like Jerry. Kramer takes a vow of silence. Elaine gets a job drawing cartoons for the New Yorker.

episodes.name: The Wizard
episodes.overview: Jerry goes down to Florida for his father's birthday. George tries to avoid Susan's parents. Elaine can't figure out her new boyfriend's nationality. Kramer decides to retire.

episodes.name: The Bookstore
episodes.overview: George is forced to buy a book he brought into the bathroom. Jerry finds out that his Uncle Leo is a shop lifter. Elaine doesn't want to be known as the office skank. Kramer and Newman start a Hong Kong rickshaw business.

episodes.name: The Maid
episodes.overview: Jerry winds up dating the maid he hired, and she starts to slack off on her duties.

episodes.name: The Clip Show (1) (a.k.a. The Chronicle (1))
episodes.overview: Just as the four are about to go to the movies, Jerry looks back on the past nine years with the audience.

episodes.name: The Finale (1)
episodes.overview: After George and Jerry land a production deal with NBC, the four head out for Paris on NBC's private plane and are waylaid in a small Massachusetts town.

title: Stranger Things
overview: When a young boy vanishes, a small town uncovers a mystery involving secret experiments, terrifying supernatural forces and one strange little girl.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Vanishing of Will Byers
episodes.overview: On his way home from a friend's house, young Will sees something terrifying. Nearby, a sinister secret lurks in the depths of a government lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Weirdo on Maple Street
episodes.overview: Lucas, Mike and Dustin try to talk to the girl they found in the woods. Hopper questions an anxious Joyce about an unsettling phone call.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: Holly, Jolly
episodes.overview: An increasingly concerned Nancy looks for Barb and finds out what Jonathan's been up to. Joyce is convinced Will is trying to talk to her.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Body
episodes.overview: Refusing to believe Will is dead, Joyce tries to connect with her son. The boys give Eleven a makeover. Nancy and Jonathan form an unlikely alliance.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flea and the Acrobat
episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Monster
episodes.overview: A frantic Jonathan looks for Nancy in the darkness, but Steve's looking for her, too. Hopper and Joyce uncover the truth about the lab's experiments.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bathtub
episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Upside Down
episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter One: MADMAX
episodes.overview: As the town preps for Halloween, a high-scoring rival shakes things up at the arcade, and a skeptical Hopper inspects a field of rotting pumpkins.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak
episodes.overview: After Will sees something terrible on trick-or-treat night, Mike wonders whether Eleven's still out there. Nancy wrestles with the truth about Barb.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Pollywog
episodes.overview: Dustin adopts a strange new pet, and Eleven grows increasingly impatient. A well-meaning Bob urges Will to stand up to his fears.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Will the Wise
episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Dig Dug
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. "Bob the Brain" tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Spy
episodes.overview: Will's connection to a shadowy evil grows stronger, but no one's quite sure how to stop it. Elsewhere, Dustin and Steve forge an unlikely bond.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Lost Sister
episodes.overview: Psychic visions draw Eleven to a band of violent outcasts and an angry girl with a shadowy past.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Mind Flayer
episodes.overview: An unlikely hero steps forward when a deadly development puts the Hawkins Lab on lockdown, trapping Will and several others inside.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Gate
episodes.overview: Eleven makes plans to finish what she started while the survivors turn up the heat on the monstrous force that's holding Will hostage.

episodes.name: Chapter One: Suzie, Do You Copy?
episodes.overview: Summer brings new jobs and budding romance. But the mood shifts when Dustin's radio picks up a Russian broadcast, and Will senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Mall Rats
episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan follow a lead, Steve and Robin sign on to a secret mission, and Max and Eleven go shopping. A rattled Billy has troubling visions.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Case of the Missing Lifeguard
episodes.overview: With El and Max looking for Billy, Will declares a day without girls. Steve and Dustin go on a stakeout, and Joyce and Hopper return to Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: The Sauna Test
episodes.overview: A code red brings the gang back together to face a frighteningly familiar evil. Karen urges Nancy to keep digging, and Robin finds a useful map.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Flayed
episodes.overview: Strange surprises lurk inside an old farmhouse and deep beneath the Starcourt Mall. Meanwhile, the Mind Flayer is gathering strength.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: E Pluribus Unum
episodes.overview: Dr. Alexei reveals what the Russians have been building, and Eleven sees where Billy has been. Dustin and Erica stage a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bite
episodes.overview: With time running out -- and an assassin close behind -- Hopper's crew races back to Hawkins, where El and the kids are preparing for war.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Battle of Starcourt
episodes.overview: Terror reigns in the food court when the Mind Flayer comes to collect. But down below, in the dark, the future of the world is at stake.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Hellfire Club
episodes.overview: El is bullied at school. Joyce opens a mysterious package. A scrappy player shakes up D&D night.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: Vecna's Curse
episodes.overview: A plane brings Mike to California — and a dead body brings Hawkins to a halt. Nancy goes looking for leads. A shaken Eddie tells the gang what he saw.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Monster and the Superhero
episodes.overview: Murray and Joyce fly to Alaska, and El faces serious consequences. Robin and Nancy dig up dirt on Hawkins' demons. Dr. Owens delivers sobering news.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Dear Billy
episodes.overview: Max is in grave danger... and running out of time. A patient at Pennhurst asylum has visitors. Elsewhere, in Russia, Hopper is hard at work.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: The Nina Project
episodes.overview: Owens takes El to Nevada, where she's forced to confront her past, while the Hawkins kids comb a crumbling house for clues. Vecna claims another victim.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: The Dive
episodes.overview: Behind the Iron Curtain, a risky rescue mission gets underway. The California crew seeks help from a hacker. Steve takes one for the team.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Massacre at Hawkins Lab
episodes.overview: As Hopper braces to battle a monster, Dustin dissects Vecna's motives — and decodes a message from beyond. El finds strength in a distant memory.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: Papa
episodes.overview: Nancy has sobering visions, and El passes an important test. Back in Hawkins, the gang gathers supplies and prepares for battle.

episodes.name: Chapter Nine: The Piggyback
episodes.overview: With selfless hearts and a clash of metal, heroes fight from every corner of the battlefield to save Hawkins — and the world itself.

episodes.name: Chapter One: The Crawl
episodes.overview: November, 1987. The gang evades the military to scour the Upside Down for Vecna — but fails to notice a threat lurking closer to home.

episodes.name: Chapter Two: The Vanishing of Holly Wheeler
episodes.overview: After a vicious attack at the Wheeler home, Mike and Nancy confront the cost of secrecy, while El and Hopper embark on a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Chapter Three: The Turnbow Trap
episodes.overview: Will gains unique insight into Vecna's next move, giving the crew an opportunity to set a trap. Holly explores her new surroundings.

episodes.name: Chapter Four: Sorcerer
episodes.overview: The military tightens its grip on the town. Mike, Lucas and Robin orchestrate a daring escape. El comes face-to-face with the enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter Five: Shock Jock
episodes.overview: The gang hatches an electrifying plan to reconnect Will to the hive mind. Tensions flare during a search of the Upside Down's Hawkins Lab.

episodes.name: Chapter Six: Escape from Camazotz
episodes.overview: As Holly and Max fight to escape Vecna's mind, El must find a way into Will's. Joyce wrestles with guilt. Jonathan and Nancy face a turning point.

episodes.name: Chapter Seven: The Bridge
episodes.overview: On the anniversary of Will's disappearance, the party reunites to prepare for a battle with world-altering implications.

episodes.name: Chapter Eight: The Rightside Up
episodes.overview: As Vecna prepares to destroy the world as we know it, the party must put everything on the line to defeat him once and for all.

title: The Walking Dead
overview: The Walking Dead tells the story of the months and years that follow after a zombie apocalypse. It follows a group of survivors, led by former police officer Rick Grimes, who travel in search of a safe and secure home. As the world overrun by the dead takes its toll on the survivors, their interpersonal conflicts present a greater danger to their continuing survival than the walkers that roam the country. Over time, the characters are changed by the constant exposure to death and some grow willing to do anything to survive.Based on the comic book series of the same name by Robert Kirkman, Tony Moore, and Charlie Adlard.

episodes.name: Days Gone Bye
episodes.overview: Rick searches for his family after emerging from a coma into a world terrorized by the walking dead. Morgan and Duane, whom he meets along the way, help teach Rick the new rules for survival.

episodes.name: Guts
episodes.overview: Rick unknowingly causes a group of survivors to be trapped by walkers. The group dynamic devolves from accusations to violence, as Rick must confront an enemy far more dangerous than the undead.

episodes.name: Tell It to the Frogs
episodes.overview: Rick makes a decision to go back to Atlanta to retrieve the bag of guns and save a man's life. Lori and Shane must deal with the surprising return of someone they thought was dead.

episodes.name: Vatos
episodes.overview: Rick's mission to Atlanta is jeopardized when things go awry. Jim becomes unhinged in camp.

episodes.name: Wildfire
episodes.overview: Rick leads the group to the CDC after the attack. Jim must make a terrible life and death decision

episodes.name: TS-19
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are allowed into the CDC by a strange doctor. But all is not what it seems in their newfound haven.

episodes.name: What Lies Ahead
episodes.overview: After the CDC explosion, the survivors are still on the move when they encounter a herd of walkers that separates one of their own, leading them to a possible safe haven.

episodes.name: Bloodletting
episodes.overview: Coming to the aid of another, Rick discovers a possible safe haven. Shane must go on a dangerous mission to get badly needed medical supplies.

episodes.name: Save the Last One
episodes.overview: The group desperately awaits Shane's return. Shane finds himself trapped in a school, surrounded by the undead. Daryl and Andrea search for someone in the woods.

episodes.name: Cherokee Rose
episodes.overview: Shane makes a deadly sacrifice which leads to unusual behavior and self-distancing. The rest of the group tries to hang on somewhere between living to die and dying to live.

episodes.name: Chupacabra
episodes.overview: Glenn, the only one breaking barriers between both groups, knows far too much for his comfort level. Daryl finds a sign of life and, in his delirium, tries to make it back to the farm alive.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Secrets are told and secrets are revealed. Hershel refuses to acknowledge the world’s new reality. Andrea comes out of her shell. Everyone is becoming more and more aware that “everything is food for something.”

episodes.name: Pretty Much Dead Already
episodes.overview: Hershel sets a deadline. All secrets are out in the open. Glenn stands up for himself and Shane takes charge.

episodes.name: Nebraska
episodes.overview: Rick and the others try to restore order in the aftermath of a terrible discovery. Hershel takes up an old habit and disappears, Rick and Glenn must follow him into town.

episodes.name: Triggerfinger
episodes.overview: Trapped, Rick, Hershel and Glenn fight to survive against new foes, both dead and alive. Shane finds Lori in danger on the road and makes it his mission to bring her back to the farm.

episodes.name: 18 Miles Out
episodes.overview: Rick and Shane come into conflict over the fate of an outsider. Andrea helps Hershel's youngest daughter face a crucial decision.

episodes.name: Judge, Jury, Executioner
episodes.overview: Rick sides with Shane on an important decision, causing Dale to worry that the group is losing its humanity. Carl's actions have unintended consequences on the group.

episodes.name: Better Angels
episodes.overview: The group learns that someone dangerous may be on the loose near the farm. As night falls, Rick, Shane, Daryl and Glenn comb the woods to handle the situation and keep the group safe.

episodes.name: Beside the Dying Fire
episodes.overview: Rick and Carl return from the woods to find the farm in jeopardy. The group is split up in the ensuing chaos. With things looking grim, Rick’s leadership is questioned.

episodes.name: Seed
episodes.overview: With the world growing increasingly more dangerous and Lori’s pregnancy advancing, Rick discovers a potentially safe haven. But first he must secure the premises, pushing his group to its limit.

episodes.name: Sick
episodes.overview: After a traumatic event, a life hangs in the balance. Complicating matters, the group must also deal with a potential threat to their new surroundings.

episodes.name: Walk with Me
episodes.overview: After witnessing an accident, Andrea and Michonne are introduced to a new community of survivors. As conflicts arise with their new acquaintances, a decision must be made.

episodes.name: Say the Word
episodes.overview: After another loss, Rick struggles. Michonne remains suspicious of the Governor as he throws a party with a unique twist for the people of Woodbury.

episodes.name: Hounded
episodes.overview: As Andrea grows closer to the Governor, Michonne makes a decision about Woodbury. Glenn and Maggie go on a run. Rick struggles.

episodes.name: When the Dead Come Knocking
episodes.overview: The Governor presses for information. A new guest arrives at the prison, forcing Rick's hand.

episodes.name: Made to Suffer
episodes.overview: Andrea steps up as the people of Woodbury are thrown into uncharted territory. At the prison, a new threat arises.

episodes.name: The Suicide King
episodes.overview: Rick tries to rescue a member of his group. Woodbury is in disarray after a recent attack. New guests raise concerns at the prison.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: As the group debates their next course of action, Rick wanders after a lost friend. Daryl and Merle question their choices. The Governor restores order in Woodbury and makes plans to punish those responsible.

episodes.name: I Ain't a Judas
episodes.overview: Their security threatened, Rick and the group must make a choice. With Woodbury in a police state, Andrea grows uneasy.

episodes.name: Clear
episodes.overview: Realizing they are heavily outgunned against the Governor's forces, Rick leads an expedition to get more weapons.

episodes.name: Arrow on the Doorpost
episodes.overview: In an effort to prevent any more deaths, Rick and the Governor meet to come up with a peace treaty.

episodes.name: Prey
episodes.overview: The Governor chases a dissenter who fled Woodbury. While the Governor is gone, a traitor tries to sabotage his upcoming plans.

episodes.name: This Sorrowful Life
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are faced with a serious problem. If they want a truce with the Governor, they will have to make a huge sacrifice.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Tombs
episodes.overview: Rick and the group have to seriously consider if the prison is worth defending as the Governor's impending attack looms over their heads.

episodes.name: 30 Days Without an Accident
episodes.overview: Rick and the group are as close to an ideal life as possible at the prison. Will they be able to hold on to humanity in the face of a new evil?

episodes.name: Infected
episodes.overview: As the group faces a brand new enemy, Rick and the others must fight to protect the livelihood they worked so hard to create at the prison.

episodes.name: Isolation
episodes.overview: As one group leaves the prison in search for supplies at a local college, those who stay must deal with recent losses while preserving what remains.

episodes.name: Indifference
episodes.overview: While on a supplies mission to a local college, members of the group run into multiple hurdles. Things at the prison are getting worse.

episodes.name: Internment
episodes.overview: Multiple enemies put pressure on Rick and the group. Could this finally be the breaking point for the survivors and the prison?
