episodes.overview: When Granny hears the Drysdales are at a horse show, she declares she wants good trotter so she can ride it to the market. When Mr. Drysdale buys a racer along with a buggy, Granny decides she wants to be the driver at the track.

episodes.name: The Cat Burglar
episodes.overview: After it becomes known that a cat burglar is in Beverly Hills, the Clampetts take precautions to protect their home. Not surprisingly, they don't really understand what a cat burglar is.

episodes.name: The Big Chicken
episodes.overview: Granny encounters an ostrich at the Drysdales and believe it's a giant chicken. She decides it got into her "medicinal tonic" and that's why it's so big. She tries to apply the idea to her vegetables.

episodes.name: Sonny Drysdale Returns
episodes.overview: The Clampetts believe resuming his courtship of Elly is why Sonny Drysdale returns. His stepfather arranges a job as a beauty product salesman and his sixth stop at the Clampetts is where his merchandise is mistaken as courting gifts.

episodes.name: Brewster's Baby
episodes.overview: Granny, along with Elly, is heading back to the hills to do some doctoring. Mr. Drysdale is frantic to stop her so he reveals that the Brewsters are having a baby. Jethro brings home some girls from the Kit Kat Club so he won't be lonely.

episodes.name: The Great Jethro
episodes.overview: A shady magician sells his wares to the gullible Jethro.

episodes.name: The Old Folks Home
episodes.overview: Jed thinks Granny needs help in cleaning the mansion, but she believes it's because he wants to put her in a retirement home, so Granny is ready to head to the hills with her money, which Mr. Drysdale is desperate to avoid.

episodes.name: Flatt and Scruggs Return
episodes.overview: Musicians Flatt and Scruggs, old friends of the Clampetts, visit with their glamorous wives. Banjo music is performed, Gladys sings a song and Granny teaches her to cook. Jethro adapts the truck to avoid traffic.

episodes.name: The Folk Singers
episodes.overview: Jethro is bent on becoming an astronaut but gets sidetracked into teaming up with Miss Jane to become a folk singer. Along the way Jethro invents a new musical device he dubs the Bodine o' phone.

episodes.name: The Beautiful Maid
episodes.overview: Drysdale, at first irate that beautiful actress Bergstrom is kept on an expensive stipend without making a film, is smitten at first sight and so places the actress in the Clampett home to learn backwoods accents and ways for a movie.

episodes.name: Jethro's Pad
episodes.overview: Jethro becomes a Hugh Hefner wannabe when he discovers some Playpen magazines in Mr. Drysdale's garage.

episodes.name: The Bird Watchers
episodes.overview: Granny remains eager to get Elly to the altar and decides Professor Biddle, Miss Jane's friend, will do. Mr. Drysdale blackmails Dash into asking the Clampett lass for a date. The meek birdwatcher and the handsome actor are soon at odds.

episodes.name: Jethro Gets Engaged
episodes.overview: Jethro is in love again and decides to get a job as an actor. Taking the name Beef Jerky, he finds himself Dash's stunt double and has a rough time at the studio. Jethro's "girl" Debbie only wants a screen test and plays up to Jed.

episodes.name: Granny Tonics a Birdwatcher
episodes.overview: Granny brews a batch of her tonic hoping it helps Elly get a husband. Jane with Mr. Biddle are trying to hatch a condor egg but a sip of the potion changes the birdwatcher's focus and the Clampetts need to get him out of a tree.

episodes.name: Jethro Goes to College
episodes.overview: Jed thinks Jethro needs to go back to school to get his mind off girls; but, instead of college, Jethro enrolls in a secretarial school that takes his money and graduates him early. At his new bank job, he hires all his classmates.

episodes.name: The Party Line
episodes.overview: Granny receives a box from Cousin Pearl in the hills. One of the items in the box is an old fashioned crank telephone. Granny asks Jethro to hook it up to a party line on the pole so she can listen in on the party line.

episodes.name: The Soup Contest
episodes.overview: Granny despairs of Elly Mae ever finding a husband and decides to promote her non-existent cooking skills. She is entered into a TV show cook-off, but nothing she fixes is edible.

episodes.name: Jethro Takes Love Lessons
episodes.overview: Jethro is in love with Susie, the carhop waitress at the local drive-in, but Susie keeps rejecting his advances. Jed advises a dejected Jethro to take dating advice from Dash Riprock, the movie star/playboy neighbor to the Clampetts. Dash advises Jethro to buy a convertible, invite Susie to go on a double date with Elly Mae and him, and even lets Jethro use his bachelor pad. Despite Dash's efforts, Jethro still can't get past his hillbilly ways to Susie's heart.

episodes.name: The Badger Game
episodes.overview: A con artist pretends to be someone from back home and stays with the Clampetts. She plans to get photos of Jed in a compromising position in order to blackmail him.

episodes.name: The Badgers Return
episodes.overview: Jethro decides to sophisticate Emaline but she has bigger plans for blackmailing Mr. Drysdale with her cuckoo clock camera. The colonel continues to woo Granny. The two swindlers though haven't met someone as sharp as Jed.

episodes.name: The Gorilla
episodes.overview: Jethro is chopping wood while a chimpanzee named May Bell watches. He wishes that he could teach May Bell to chop wood. When Elly May comes by, she and Jethro talk and decide that they want a gorilla.

episodes.name: Come Back, Little Herby
episodes.overview: The Clampetts miss Herbie and ask Mr. Drysdale to get the tame gorilla back. The banker promises to help but actually hinders the effort.

episodes.name: Jed in Politics
episodes.overview: Granny's soap making sends noxious smoke into the air, which gets the attention of smog commissioner Tinsley. He shuts down the operation and Jed decides to run against him when he misunderstands Mr. Drysdale's advice.

episodes.name: Clampett Cha Cha Cha
episodes.overview: Granny wins free lessons from a supposedly acclaimed dance school.

episodes.name: Jed Joins the Board
episodes.overview: Jed takes a job on the board of directors of O.K. Oil Company.

episodes.name: Granny Lives It Up
episodes.overview: Cushing makes another attempt to get the Clampetts to move their money to his bank by romancing Granny. When Drysdale learns of this, he decides to bring his father-in-law Lowell Farquhar, who had once dated Granny, to draw Granny away from Cushing.

episodes.name: The Gloria Swanson Story
episodes.overview: Gloria Swanson and Drysdale are doing some business which involves her selling her house and some of her possessions and donating the proceeds to charity and then she is moving East. When the Clampetts read about her moving away, Jethro who heard the story that she's auctioning off her things, thinks that she's broke and that she's being forced to sell her possessions. Granny being a big fan is heart broken. They go to see her and try to lift up her spirits by saying they like her movies and that they're still being shown in their hometown. Jed decides to ask Chapman, who runs his movie studio, to make a silent movie with Swanson in it.

episodes.name: The Woodchucks
episodes.overview: Jethro is so desperate to meet a woman that when Miss Hathaway's bird watching group arrives, he goes out of his way to try to impress the women.

episodes.name: Foggy Mountain Soap
episodes.overview: Flatt and Scruggs are visiting to film a TV commercial for a detergent. Commodore Ratterman thinks the Clampett authenticity would help sell the soap. He doesn't count on their honesty or Jethro's incompetence as a director

episodes.name: The Christmas Present
episodes.overview: In order to buy Mrs. Drysdale a special Christmas present, the Clampetts take seasonal jobs in a department store

episodes.name: The Flying Saucer
episodes.overview: Granny discovers Martians next door at the Drysdale mansion.

episodes.name: The Mayor of Bug Tussle
episodes.overview: Amos Wentworth Hogg, Mayor of Bug Tussle, travels to Beverly Hills to visit the Clampetts with hopes of raising money to cover an embezzlement debt. The Clampetts, however, believe he has eyes for Granny.

episodes.name: Granny Retires
episodes.overview: Granny decides to take her share of the Clampett millions and move back home.

episodes.name: The Clampett Curse
episodes.overview: Jed and Granny decide to donate the burden of their millions to some college students and move back home.

episodes.name: The Indians Are Coming
episodes.overview: When Crowfoot Indians come to Beverly Hills to discuss a boundary dispute at the Clampett oil field, Granny prepares for war.

episodes.name: The Marriage Machine
episodes.overview: Jethro goes to a computer dating service, and Granny follows to find a date for Jed.

episodes.name: Elly Comes Out
episodes.overview: After reading the Society page Granny decides to best way to get Elly a husband is to throw her a coming out party, complete with possum burgers and gopher gravy. Mrs. Drysdale, hoping to forever humiliate them, is all too happy to help.

episodes.name: The Matador
episodes.overview: Jethro learns about bullfighting and decides bring a matador would be a perfect job. El Magnifico is to teach him but then he meets Ellie Mae and wants to marry the Clampett heiress. Her concern is for the bulls.

episodes.name: The Gypsy's Warning
episodes.overview: The Clampetts come across Narda and Yerko, two gypsies, who decide to run a scam on the unsuspecting clan. Involving both a marriage prophecy and and a curse, the crooks see the families 's naivety to their advantage.

episodes.name: His Royal Highness
episodes.overview: The Clampetts are visited by a real king, Alexander so Granny and Mrs. Drysdale start matchmaking. The broke royal needs a wealthy bride and courts Ellie. Drysdale niece Doreen is tricked by a costumed Jethro and ends up unimpressed.

episodes.name: Super Hawg
episodes.overview: The Drysdales have temporary custody of a baby hippo and when Granny spots it she thinks it's a giant hog. She makes plans for turning into future meals while Ellie sees it as another pet.

episodes.name: The Doctors
episodes.overview: Granny continues her doctoring and is especially pleased with her new batch of tonic. Dr. Clyburn is determined to get her to stop so invites her to his office to show her how modern medicine works. Granny has other ideas.

episodes.name: Delovely and Scruggs
episodes.overview: Country music legends Lester Flatt and Earl Scruggs visit the Clampetts while Lester's "citified" wife, Gladys, heads to Mammoth Studios for a screen test directed by Jethro (at Lester's request).

episodes.name: The Little Monster
episodes.overview: The Clampetts agree to watch their banker's nephew Milby but they don't know he's spoiled rotten. His behavior tests the patience of all, especially Granny who has a few ideas on teaching him manners.

episodes.name: The Dahlia Feud
episodes.overview: Mrs. Drysdale's dahlias spark a feud with the Clampett's when Margaret Drysdale accuses Granny of theft.

episodes.name: Jed Inherits a Castle
episodes.overview: Jed Clampett has inherited a castle in the English countryside. Jethro insists that everyone, except Granny, wear the royal raiment's of Elizabeth (the First, of course).

episodes.name: The Clampetts in London
episodes.overview: The Clampetts head to England to visit the castle Jed inherited. Misunderstandings abound, from Jethro mistaking San Francisco for London, to the impounding of Granny's medical supplies, to the real intentions of the elderly chemist.

episodes.name: Clampett Castle
episodes.overview: The Clampetts finally make it to their new castle and try to adjust to the English way of castle life, at the least the way Jethro thinks it is, based on his understanding of English myths and legends.

episodes.name: Robin Hood of Griffith Park
episodes.overview: Granny wants to leave England until she thinks the feudal system means feuding with the neighboring castle. Once back in America Jethro decides to continue his Robin Hood ways in a local version of Sherwood Forest.

episodes.name: Robin Hood and the Sheriff
episodes.overview: Jethro continues his life as Robin Hood in Griffin Park. He's attracted a large group of hippies who still don't realize Jethro has no idea what he's doing.

episodes.name: Greetings from the President
episodes.overview: When Jethro gets his draft notice Jed decides he should pay what it costs the Army to train inductees. When Mr. Drysdale hears this he starts figuring how he can get Jethro out on a Section 8.

episodes.name: The Army Game
episodes.overview: Jethro reports to the induction center after getting his draft notice. The Army isn't quite sure what to make of Jethro.

episodes.name: Mr. Universe Muscles In
episodes.overview: Elly May has a new beau and he's Mr. Universe Dave Draper but the Clampetts are concerned about his muscles. Doctor Granny is convince he is afflicted with barbell bloat and aims to cure him.

episodes.name: A Plot for Granny
episodes.overview: Since Granny can't plant crops in their yard, Jed thinks the solution is to buy her a plot a land somewhere else. He figures a place called Happy Valley is the best spot to buy land, not realizing it's a cemetery.

episodes.name: The Social Climbers
episodes.overview: Granny's old friend the widow Adaline Ashley comes to Beverly Hills, and Granny sets to playing matchmaker for her and Jed. Mrs. Drysdale and her snooty friends are misled to believe Adaline is a socialite jet setter.

episodes.name: Jethro's Military Career
episodes.overview: Jethro thinks he wants to be a naval frogman but Granny is concerned her tonic has transformed him. Mr. Drysdale, concerned about finances, has Miss Jane distract Jethro with comics causing him to want to fly to the moon.

episodes.name: The Reserve Program
episodes.overview: Jethro heads down to the Reserves HQ while wearing an ancestor's Confederate Army uniform. The Sergeant thinks he's an actor there to participate in a Civil War reenactment. Jethro runs home to tell Granny the Civil War is still on.

episodes.name: The South Rises Again
episodes.overview: Granny confuses a movie with a restart of the Civil War, convincing Ellie and Jethro to join the Confederates. Granny wounds the actor playing Grant with Ellie's cookies, taking him to cure him with her "rheumatism" medicine.

episodes.name: Jethro in the Reserve
episodes.overview: Col. Blake asks the actor playing Gen. Grant to play along with Granny so that the Civil War movie can continue. Meanwhile, Jethro uses his 6th grade education to take the written test to enter the Reserves.

episodes.name: Cimarron Drip
episodes.overview: Jethro believes his moment for Hollywood stardom has arrived. Casting for Bachelor Sheriff Knows Best is occurring and Jethro mistakenly thinks he has been chosen.

episodes.name: Corn Pone Picassos
episodes.overview: Granny competes against Mrs. Drysdale as artists and tells Jed about her uncle the barn painter. Jed and Jethro go to an upscale gallery to buy a painting but are mistaken for gardeners. Bessie the chimp dabbles with a paintbrush.

episodes.name: The Clampetts Play Cupid
episodes.overview: After Ellie seems to be no longer interested in Dash Riprock Granny decides it's time to do a little matchmaking. She thinks the handsome actor would be perfect for Miss Jane.

episodes.name: The Housekeeper
episodes.overview: Mr. Drysdale talks the Clampetts into hiring a housekeeper. Unfortunately, the housekeeper that is hired is uninterested in doing housework.

episodes.name: The Diner
episodes.overview: Jethro decides to turn his favorite thing eating into a job by getting the family involved in buying a diner. The family's choice of offerings lead to a lack of customers so Mr. Drysdale tries to fix things.

episodes.name: Topless Anyone?
episodes.overview: Jethro, worried that his diner the Hungry Gizzard has no customers, has a wonderful idea. He busts in on Mr. Drysdale trying to impress the wealthy Vanderponts, announcing the restaurant is going topless. Confusion ensues.

episodes.name: The Great Snow
episodes.overview: Granny wants to leave sunny California because she misses the winter season sending Mr. Drysdale into a panic. The banker enlists Miss Jane in an elaborate scheme to convince the Clampetts that a blizzard has occurred.

episodes.name: The Rass'lin' Clampetts
episodes.overview: After Mrs. Drysdale complains to Granny they have a physical brawl. It leads to Jethro explaining to Jed and Granny about TV wrestling. While watching Granny thinks its real so she decides to rescue Rebecca, one of the performers.

episodes.name: The Great Tag-Team Match
episodes.overview: The last televised wrestling match was such a success that the promoter wants a rematch. Granny isn't interested until Rebecca's "parents" visit.

episodes.name: Jethro Proposes
episodes.overview: Granny is worried about Miss Jane's spinsterhood and convinces Jethro to ask her to marry him. Granny assures him that she will decline the proposal, but Hathaway accepts, leading to panic in the Clampett household.

episodes.name: The Clampetts Fiddle Around
episodes.overview: Jethro is on to his next big idea and wants to play the violin. Jed asks Miss Jane to find a teacher and she hires Stromboli, a famed classical virtuoso. But the Clampetts want fiddle music so they find someone else.

episodes.name: The Soap Opera
episodes.overview: Granny confuses a soap opera with real life and decides her doctoring can save Dr. Rex Goodbody from a terminal illness.

episodes.name: Dog Days
episodes.overview: Granny is on the warpath concerning the chaos caused by Ellie's critters and declares either they go or she does. Mr. Drysdale is equally irritated by the expense of his wife's poodle. Jed tries to find a solution.

episodes.name: The Crystal Gazers
episodes.overview: Granny and Jethro believe they have psychic abilities, but Granny's predictions stop coming true. With her reputation on the line, she picks a stock for Mr. Drysdale that could cost him a small fortune.

episodes.name: From Rags to Riches
episodes.overview: Granny and Jethro believe they have psychic abilities, but Granny's predictions stop coming true. With her reputation on the line, she picks a stock for Mr. Drysdale that could cost him a small fortune.

episodes.name: Cousin Roy
episodes.overview: Cousin Roy from back home comes to visit and to open up a distribution point for Mother Myrtle's Tonic. Granny isn't very keen on any competition against her own tonic.

episodes.name: A Bundle for Britain
episodes.overview: The Clampetts are concerned Mr. Drysdale is worrying too much about their money. When Jethro misunderstands and believes Britain's queen is broke, the family heads to their English castle to help her out.

episodes.name: Something for the Queen
episodes.overview: Heading to England Jethro smuggles Ellie's turkey buzzard on the plane upsetting Mr. Drysdale and a fellow passenger. After landing they try to meet with the Queen to give her their 80 million dollars. Their butler Faversham tries to clear things up.

episodes.name: Coming Through the Rye
episodes.overview: While in England, Jethro falls for a young lady, but the Clampetts thinks a man wearing the kilt is the girl that Jethro has fallen for.

episodes.name: Ghost of Clampett Castle
episodes.overview: In an attempt to get the Clampetts to move back to California, Mr. Drysdale tells Granny about the spirit of Lady Clementine. Her husband was murdered in the Clampett castle. Lady Clementine's ghost is going to return to seek revenge on the person who killed her husband; her little old grandmother.

episodes.name: Granny Goes to Hooterville
episodes.overview: After the Clampetts return from London, Granny gets a letter from Hooterville asking her to help with Betty Jo Elliot's baby.

episodes.name: The Italian Cook
episodes.overview: While Granny is away in Hooterville, Mr. Drysdale hires a gorgeous Italian cook who speaks no English.

episodes.name: The Great Cook-Off
episodes.overview: Granny and the Italian chef compete to see who will cook for the family.

episodes.name: Bonnie, Flatt, and Scruggs
episodes.overview: Jethro and Elly dress up in Bonnie and Clyde costumes and end up scaring Mr. Drysdale; to get back at them, Mr. Drysdale dresses up as a bank robber but gets caught.

episodes.name: The Thanksgiving Spirit
episodes.overview: The Clampetts spend Thanksgiving in Hooterville.

episodes.name: The Courtship of Homer Noodleman
episodes.overview: Mr. Drysdale casts Dash Riprock as Homer Noodleman, a potential new lover for Elly May.

episodes.name: The Hot-Rod Truck
episodes.overview: Jethro wants a new identity with replacement of their old truck with a modern hot rod. Granny wants to stay with the old truck. To prove how good the old truck is Granny races Jethro in his hot rod.

episodes.name: The Week Before Christmas
episodes.overview: The Clampetts prepare to go to Hooterville for Christmas.

episodes.name: Christmas in Hooterville
episodes.overview: The Clampetts return to Hooterville to celebrate Christmas. Mr. Drysdale, convinced that Mr. Clampett intends to move all of his money to Mr. Drucker's bank, drives to Hooterville to stop him.

episodes.name: Drysdale and Friend
episodes.overview: Mr. Drysdale follows the Clampetts and Miss Jane to Hooterville where they are spending Christmas. He takes Ellie's bear Fairchild with him and gets himself thrown in jail in a little town. Sam Drucker shows up to help.

episodes.name: Problem Bear
episodes.overview: Mr. Drysdale is sick and Dr. Granny springs into action with a chimp as a nurse. But Ellie's bear Fairchild has taken a liking to granny's "flu" remedy. During this, Mrs. Drysdale tries to impress society matron Mrs. Van Ransohoff.

episodes.name: Jethro the Flesh Peddler
episodes.overview: Jethro's new plan is to become a big-time talent agent, and his first action is hiring beautiful Babs and Bunny. Cousin Roy, told he has musical gifts, arrives but Jethro refuses to accept him as a client which upsets the other Clampetts.

episodes.name: Cousin Roy in Movieland
episodes.overview: Jethro agrees to take on cousin Roy as a client but then he changes everything that made the banjo player likeable. Granny, Jed, and Ellie are dismayed but a hit record happens in spite of Jethro.

episodes.name: Jed Clampett Enterprises
episodes.overview: Jethro is evicted because his 50-cent allowance won't cover the rent. The other Clampetts take over the space: Granny will cut hair or pull teeth, Jed will sharpen tools and whittle things, and Elly is the pretty receptionist.

episodes.name: The Phantom Fifth Floor
episodes.overview: With the Clampetts established "in business" in Jethro's vacated office space, a building inspector visits to find out about their business operations on the 5th floor.

episodes.name: The Hired Gun
episodes.overview: Mr. Drysdale hires a "troubleshooter" for the bank. His main mission is to get the Clampetts to close their business operating out of the 5th floor.

episodes.name: The Happy Bank
episodes.overview: Granny provides Homer Cratchit with a baldness cure which makes the other employees curious about what's going on on the 5th floor. One secretary sets her sights on marrying Jed.

episodes.name: Sam Drucker's Visit
episodes.overview: Sam Drucker comes to Beverly Hills to visit and Granny assumes he's interested in courting her.

episodes.name: The Guru
episodes.overview: Jethro meets Mrs. Drysdale's guru and decides he wants to be one also. Granny thinks it's all nonsense but when she tries to put a stop to it the followers find her common sense inspiring and make her the head guru.

episodes.name: The Jogging Clampetts
episodes.overview: The Drysdales now jog, so the banker can get the account of Jason Detweiler, head of a running club. The Clampetts don't understand the concept, leading to misunderstandings, then Elly and Jethro become enthusiastic.

episodes.name: Collard Greens an' Fatback
episodes.overview: Famous singer Pat Boone is in the neighborhood and smells Granny's cooking. He wanders into their backyard and the Clampetts befriend him, thinking he's a hill country man down on his luck.

episodes.name: Back to the Hills
episodes.overview: Granny is worried that Elly Mae is an old maid at 20 while Jed is concerned about Jethro joining college protesters. They both miss the hills, so they decide to head back to the Ozarks, which upsets Mr. Drysdale.

episodes.name: The Hills of Home
episodes.overview: After settling in at Silver Dollar City Jed, Granny, and Ellie greet old friends. Granny meets up with her old rival Elverna Bradshaw and restarts her feud. Jethro continues his college protests back in California.

episodes.name: Silver Dollar City Fair
episodes.overview: The Clampets travel back to the hills to attend the Silver Dollar Fair. Granny and Elverna Bradshaw compete to find mates for their kin.

episodes.name: Jane Finds Elly a Man
episodes.overview: Miss Jane lends a hand in Granny's race to get Elly May married-off before Elverna Bradshaw's daughter, and finds an unwed winner wandering in the woods.

episodes.name: Wedding Plans
episodes.overview: The family begins to make plans for Elly May's upcoming wedding to Matthew, but Mr. Drysdale finds himself preoccupied during the entire matter by the prospects that the wedding will lead him to lose his biggest account.

episodes.name: Jed Buys Central Park
episodes.overview: After Elly's wedding plans fall through because Matthew is unavailable, the Clampetts leave Silver Dollar City. They head to New York City where they encounter their old "friend", conman Shifty Shafer, who sells them Central Park.

episodes.name: The Clampetts in New York
episodes.overview: Honest John continues to show the Clampetts around New York trying to "sell" them as many landmarks as possible. The police have given him a twenty four hour notice while Miss Jane and Mr. Drysdale try to get there to stop the con job.

episodes.name: Manhattan Hillbillies
episodes.overview: The Clampetts settle on their new property of Central Park and Jed starts building a log cabin. Granny looks for possums but meets muggers instead giving them a lesson in manners. Mr. Drysdale pleads with them to return to California.

episodes.name: Home Again
episodes.overview: The Clampetts return to their mansion and Mr. Drysdale claims the veterinarian Dr. Graham is perfect for Elly. But Granny, after breaking her glasses, mistakes a seal for the veterinarian, leading to a series of misunderstandings.

episodes.name: Shorty Kellems Moves West
episodes.overview: Shorty Kellems comes to Beverly Hills for a visit. Mr. Drysdale misunderstands a conversation and mistakenly believes Shorty is wealthier than Jed, and begins to indulge him in every way possible to win his account.

episodes.name: Midnight Shorty
episodes.overview: Mr. Drysdale continues his misguided campaign to win Shorty Kellems as a depositor, and Shorty gleefully binges on all the attractive inducements.

episodes.name: Shorty Go Home
episodes.overview: Jethro is leading a wild life with Shorty. Granny is determined to get Shorty to return to the hills. Meanwhile, Mr. Drysdale would like Shorty to invest his money with the bank... enlisting the secretarial pool to persuade him!

episodes.name: The Hero
episodes.overview: Mrs. Drysdale's favorite nephew, Lance "Jetstream" Bradford, who after ten years is still a 2nd Lieutenant in the Air Force, comes for a visit. Milburn reluctantly gives him a job.

episodes.name: Our Hero the Banker
episodes.overview: Lance is desperate to land a new depositor for the bank and tells Milburn he's bringing in an Air Force General.

episodes.name: Buzz Bodine, Boy General
episodes.overview: Jethro comes to Hooterville in a general's uniform.

episodes.name: The Clampett-Hewes Empire
episodes.overview: The Clampetts are rumored to be merging their interests with a rich tycoon.

episodes.name: What Happened to Shorty?
episodes.overview: Shorty Kellems delays his marriage to Elverna Bradshaw by having Mr. Drysdale throw him a wild bachelor party.

episodes.name: Marry Me, Shorty
episodes.overview: Elverna continues dragging Shorty to a Las Vegas wedding, as Mr. Drysdale deals with consequences from Shorty's bachelor party.

episodes.name: Shorty Spits the Hook
episodes.overview: Shorty thinks he's figured out a way to avoid marrying Elverna Bradshaw.

episodes.name: Three-Day Reprieve
episodes.overview: Shorty Kellems spends the three day waiting period before marriage taking repeated "dips" in the bank's secretarial pool.

episodes.name: The Wedding
episodes.overview: Shorty finally gets married, but it's to the wrong woman.

episodes.name: Annul That Marriage
episodes.overview: The Clampetts run Shorty's city bride, Gloria, through the rigors of rural living, trying to convince her she should annul her marriage to Shorty.

episodes.name: Hotel for Women
episodes.overview: When Granny induces Jed, Elly, and Jethro to move into the nostalgic old cabin, Shorty Kellems exploits the now-unoccupied mansion.

episodes.name: Simon Legree Drysdale
episodes.overview: Shorty's been sent back to the hills, but the Clampetts still have all his girl boarders to deal with in the mansion; and Mr. Drysdale has serious trouble when Jean Bell's brothers get the mistaken idea that he has enslaved their sister.

episodes.name: Honest John Returns
episodes.overview: Honest John shows up with another scheme to get the Clampett millions for himself. Convincing them he's invented machines to blow the smog away, Jed finds trying to get his money from Mr. Drysdale nearly impossible.

episodes.name: Honesty is the Best Policy
episodes.overview: Flo Shafer is intent on helping Shifty regain his scheming composure.

episodes.name: The Clampetts in Washington
episodes.overview: The Shafers meet the Clampetts in in Washington D.C. to "broker" more prime real estate.

episodes.name: Jed Buys the Capitol
episodes.overview: After Honest John explains to Jed why they couldn't visit the White House, he sells them other Washington landmarks each conveniently only $1 million. Mr. Drysdale finds out and sends Miss Jane to bring the Clampetts home.

episodes.name: Mark Templeton Arrives
episodes.overview: Rev. Matthew's lookalike brother Mark, a Naval officer, shows up to meet Elly May. The two head to the cement pond, but later when Granny sees Mark in his diving gear, she is convinced that the water turns him into a man-frog.

episodes.name: Don't Marry a Frogman
episodes.overview: Elly continues dating Navy man Mark. Granny objects, convinced he is part frog. While Jed tries to keep Mark from eating his daughter's cooking, Granny works to find a cure for his amphibious ways.

episodes.name: Doctor, Cure My Frog
episodes.overview: Granny is desperate to keep Mark from being a frog so he can eventually marry Elly. She heads to the bank, believing that if Miss Jane kisses the frog, it will become human again. Jane refers her to psychiatrist Dr. Klingner.

episodes.name: Do You Elly Take This Frog?
episodes.overview: Granny goes to extreme measures to keep Elly from Mark, who she's convinced is turning the family into frogs. Mark tells Jed more about his naval duties, especially about harvesting food from the sea.

episodes.name: The Frog Family
episodes.overview: Granny remains convinced that Mark is turning the rest of the Clampetts into frogs. She takes the amphibians to psychiatrist Dr. Klingner in the belief he is able to return them back into humans.

episodes.name: Farm in the Ocean
episodes.overview: Mark shows Granny and the rest of the family a film about his navy job to help her understand his frogman activities. She remains unconvinced. Mr. Drysdale is alarmed that Jed wants to invest millions in underwater farms.

episodes.name: Shorty to the Rescue
episodes.overview: Shorty returns and Granny convinces him to pretend to be Elly's boyfriend to drive Mark away. Mr. Drysdale tells Jed that the idea of him giving millions to the ocean project has made Miss Jane mentally unstable.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Family
episodes.overview: Granny and Mr. Drysdale are desperate for different reasons. Granny hopes that if Mark tastes Elly's cooking, he will leave. Mr. Drysdale dresses as Napoleon Bonaparte to keep Jed from investing in Mark's ocean project.

episodes.name: The Grunion Invasion
episodes.overview: When the Clampetts learn that the grunion are due on the California coast, and having no idea who or what grunion are, head down to the beach to defend it from invasion.

episodes.name: The Girls from Grun
episodes.overview: Mr. Drysdale's latest ploy, involving duping the Clampetts into believing that the annual running of the grunion fish is an invasion by the people of Grun, backfires when Miss Hathaway organizes the female bank employees in protest.

episodes.name: The Grun Incident
episodes.overview: The women employees at the bank rebel against Mr. Drysdale's unfair work practices and he locks them in his office. The Clampetts are caught in the middle where Jed tries to hear both sides but Granny takes action.

episodes.name: Women's Lib
episodes.overview: Miss Jane and the bank's secretarial staff foment a revolution against Mr. Drysdale's repression that spills over into the Clampett's family life.

episodes.name: The Teahouse of Jed Clampett
episodes.overview: Jed and Jethro get help from a karate expert's geisha girls to run the mansion, while Granny, Elly, and the bank's secretaries all move into Miss Jane's small studio apartment as a headquarters for their cause.

episodes.name: The Palace of Clampett San
episodes.overview: Miss Jane and the women continue their crusade against male chauvinism, but they must overcome centuries of Japanese culture, Mr. Drysdale, and Jethro's giant "intellect".

episodes.name: Lib and Let Lib
episodes.overview: Life gets back to "normal" with the Clampetts, but Jethro, Mr. Drysdale, and Banzai have adjustments to make.

episodes.name: Elly, the Working Girl
episodes.overview: Elly May decides to actually start working at the bank and to move in with Jane Hathaway to her apartment. While Drysdale tries to persuade Phinney the landlord to sabotage them

episodes.name: Elly, the Secretary
episodes.overview: Jethro's childhood sweetheart Louellen comes to visit the Clampetts, who believe that she wants to marry Jethro. Jethro panics and runs away because he thinks that marrying a hillbilly girl like Louellen would damage his image as a sophisticated international playboy. Elly May starts her new job as a secretary for Mr. Drysdale, who is nice to Miss Hathaway only when Elly May is around.

episodes.name: Love Finds Jane Hathaway
episodes.overview: Dick Bremerkamp, a penniless actor, learns the Clampetts are millionaires and courts Elly.

episodes.name: The Clampetts Meet Robert Audubon Getty
episodes.overview: Unemployed actor Dick Bremerkamp expands his repertoire of guises as he works his way into the Clampett fortune.

episodes.name: Jethro Returns
episodes.overview: The final show of the series. Elly May's intended husband may win out in marrying her for her money. Hathaway tries to expose his plan to Drysdale, Granny and Jed. Jethro may wed as well but may or may not return to California.
